title.zh: 山西，从大同到洛阳，2026 年秋
title.en: Shanxi, from Datong to Luoyang, autumn 2026

lede.zh: 从北京出发，经大同的云冈石窟、悬空寺和应县木塔，过雁门关到忻州古城，太原的晋祠，一路往南到小西天、壶口瀑布、永乐宫和鹳雀楼，过黄河到洛阳，看龙门石窟、二里头和洛阳博物馆。
lede.en: From Beijing to Datong's Yungang Grottoes, the Hanging Temple and the Yingxian wooden pagoda, over Yanmen Pass to old Xinzhou and Jinci at Taiyuan, south to Xiaoxitian, Hukou Falls, Yongle Palace and the Stork Tower, and across the Yellow River to Luoyang for the Longmen Grottoes, Erlitou and the Luoyang Museum.

days.bz: 出发前在北京城南，上午在陶然亭公园，湖边的慈悲庵；然后去了法源寺，唐代就有的古刹，院子里立着一通通石碑。下午坐车往西北去大同。
days.be: Southern Beijing before setting off: Taoranting Park and the Cibei Hermitage by the lake in the morning, then Fayuan Temple, founded in the Tang, its courtyards full of stelae. West to Datong in the afternoon.

days.zh: 云冈、悬空寺和应县木塔
days.en: Yungang, the Hanging Temple and the Yingxian Pagoda
days.bz: 一早在大同城西的云冈石窟，北魏开凿的大佛，崖前还留着古道上的车辙。中午往东南到浑源的悬空寺，一座木构的寺院钉在峭壁半腰上。下午到应县，先看净土寺殿里金色的藻井，再去佛宫寺的释迦塔，辽代的木塔，九百多年没用一根钉子。
days.be: The Yungang Grottoes west of Datong first thing, Northern Wei Buddhas cut into the cliff, cart ruts from the old road still in the rock. The Hanging Temple at Hunyuan at midday, a timber monastery pinned halfway up a cliff. Yingxian in the afternoon: the gilded coffered ceiling of Jingtu Temple, then the Sakyamuni Pagoda of Fogong Temple, a Liao wooden tower standing for over nine hundred years.

days.zh: 大同、雁门关和忻州古城
days.en: Datong, Yanmen Pass and old Xinzhou
days.bz: 上午在大同城里，辽金时代的寺院，殿里的藻井、佛像和壁画。中午往南到雁门关，关城和长城都泡在雾里。傍晚到忻州古城，天黑后城楼和牌坊都亮了灯。
days.be: Liao and Jin temples in Datong in the morning, with coffered ceilings, Buddhas and murals. South to Yanmen Pass at midday, the fort and the Great Wall lost in fog. Old Xinzhou by evening, its gate towers and archways lit up after dark.

days.bz: 上午在太原的北齐壁画博物馆，墓里揭下来的出行图和人物。中午到城西南的晋祠，泉水从祠下流出来。下午在山西博物院，甲骨、造像碑和大幅的壁画。
days.be: The Northern Qi murals museum in Taiyuan in the morning, processions and figures lifted from tombs. Jinci southwest of the city at midday, springs running out beneath the shrines. The Shanxi Museum in the afternoon: oracle bones, a Buddhist stele and great murals.

days.bz: 上午在隰县的小西天，一间不大的殿里挤满了明代的彩塑。下午到壶口瀑布，黄河在这里收进一道石槽，满河的黄水翻着浪。
days.be: Xiaoxitian at Xi County in the morning, a small hall crammed with painted Ming sculpture. Hukou Falls in the afternoon, where the Yellow River squeezes into a rock channel, all brown water and spray.

days.en: Yongle Palace and the Stork Tower
days.bz: 到芮城的永乐宫，元代的道观，殿里的壁画是整座搬迁过来的。然后去风陵渡边的鹳雀楼，「欲穷千里目，更上一层楼」。
days.be: Yongle Palace at Ruicheng, a Yuan Daoist temple whose murals were moved here wall and all. Then the Stork Tower by the Fenglingdu crossing, the tower of 'climb one more storey to see a thousand li'.

days.bz: 过了黄河到洛阳。一早在龙门石窟，伊河两岸的山崖上凿满了佛龛。中午在城东的汉魏洛阳城一带，下午到偃师的二里头，看夏都遗址博物馆。
days.be: Across the Yellow River to Luoyang. The Longmen Grottoes first thing, niches crowding the cliffs on both banks of the Yi. Around the ruins of Han–Wei Luoyang at midday, and the Erlitou site museum at Yanshi in the afternoon.

days.bz: 最后一天在洛阳博物馆，从新石器的陶器到汉代的熹平石经，还有唐代的大秦景教经幢。
days.be: A last day at the Luoyang Museum, from Neolithic pottery to the Xiping stone classics of the Han and a Tang Nestorian pillar.

lede.zh: 从荷兰北上，在瑞典西海岸的哥德堡住了几天：港口、克朗堡垒、大教堂和海事博物馆。
lede.en: North from Holland for a few days in Gothenburg on Sweden's west coast: the harbour, Skansen Kronan, the cathedral and the maritime museum.

days.bz: 到哥德堡，古斯塔夫·阿道夫广场上立着城市创建者的铜像。中午在约塔河边，河口的港口一直开到海上，海鸥蹲在木桩上。
days.be: Gothenburg: the founder king in bronze on Gustaf Adolfs torg. The Göta River at noon, the harbour opening out towards the sea, a gull on a post.

days.bz: 晚上九点，太阳还没落，爬上城南小山上的克朗堡垒，十七世纪末修的圆堡，山坡上架着老炮，整座城铺在夕阳里。
days.be: Nine in the evening and the sun still up: up the hill to Skansen Kronan, a round fort of the late seventeenth century, old cannon on the slope and the whole city in the low light.

days.bz: 在城里，哥德堡大学的主楼，然后到黄色的大教堂。晚上在公园里散步。
days.be: In town: the main building of the University of Gothenburg, then the yellow cathedral. A walk in the park at night.

days.bz: 下午在海事博物馆和水族馆，一层是珊瑚礁的大水缸，楼上是一艘艘船模，从东印度公司的帆船到二十世纪的货轮。
days.be: The maritime museum and aquarium in the afternoon: a great reef tank downstairs, and upstairs ship model after ship model, from East Indiamen to twentieth-century freighters.

days.bz: 最后一个上午在港边和广场上走了走，远处是利瑟贝里游乐园的塔。
days.be: A last morning by the harbour and in the squares, the tower of Liseberg amusement park in the distance.

title.zh: 比利时和荷兰，2026 年夏

span.zh: 2026 年 6 月 20 日至 7 月 6 日

lede.zh: 从布鲁塞尔出发，经布鲁日、根特、安特卫普北上，走过多德雷赫特、鹿特丹、代尔夫特、海牙、阿姆斯特丹和乌得勒支；再往东到高费吕沃，沿莱茵河进德国的克桑滕、杜塞尔多夫和亚琛，从马斯特里赫特、列日、鲁汶回到滑铁卢。
lede.en: From Brussels north by way of Bruges, Ghent and Antwerp, through Dordrecht, Rotterdam, Delft, The Hague, Amsterdam and Utrecht; east to the Hoge Veluwe, along the Rhine into Germany at Xanten, Düsseldorf and Aachen, and back through Maastricht, Liège and Leuven to Waterloo.

days.bz: 到布鲁塞尔，下午在比利时皇家美术馆，从马格利特一路看到老勃鲁盖尔的《伯利恒户口调查》。
days.be: Brussels, and an afternoon in the Royal Museums of Fine Arts, from Magritte back to Bruegel the Elder's Census at Bethlehem.

days.bz: 上午在布鲁日，运河边的老房子和教堂里的彩色玻璃。下午到根特，伯爵城堡立在河边；傍晚到安特卫普中央车站。
days.be: Bruges in the morning, old houses along the canals and stained glass in the church. Ghent in the afternoon, the Gravensteen by the river; Antwerp Central Station by evening.

days.bz: 在安特卫普，圣母大教堂的大门和木雕祭坛，大广场上的市政厅和布拉博喷泉。下午在皇家美术馆。
days.be: Antwerp: the doors of the Cathedral of Our Lady and its carved altarpieces, the town hall and the Brabo fountain on the Grote Markt. The Royal Museum of Fine Arts in the afternoon.

days.zh: 普朗坦印刷所和多德雷赫特
days.bz: 上午在安特卫普的普朗坦-莫雷图斯博物馆，十六世纪的印刷所，铅字盒、老地图还摆在原处。中午过了边境到布雷达，下午在多德雷赫特。
days.be: The Plantin-Moretus Museum in Antwerp in the morning, a sixteenth-century printing house, type cases and old maps still in place. Over the border to Breda at midday, and Dordrecht in the afternoon.

days.bz: 在鹿特丹，伊拉斯谟的铜像，大战后修复的圣劳伦斯教堂。晚上在马斯河边。
days.be: Rotterdam: the statue of Erasmus and the Laurenskerk, rebuilt after the war. The Maas at night.

days.bz: 在小孩堤防，运河两边一排风车，十八世纪修来给低地排水。博物馆里讲荷兰人怎么和水过日子。
days.be: Kinderdijk, a row of windmills along the canals, built in the eighteenth century to drain the polders, and a museum on living with water.

days.bz: 在代尔夫特，老教堂里的彩色玻璃和墓，新教堂的管风琴，市集广场上立着格劳秀斯的铜像。
days.be: Delft: stained glass and tombs in the Old Church, the organ in the New Church, and Grotius in bronze on the market square.

days.bz: 上午在海牙的莫瑞泰斯皇家美术馆，看《戴珍珠耳环的少女》。然后是埃舍尔博物馆，还有斯宾诺莎最后住过的房子，墙上写着「斯宾诺莎在此居住 1671–1677」。
days.be: The Mauritshuis in The Hague in the morning, and the Girl with a Pearl Earring. Then the Escher museum, and the house where Spinoza spent his last years: 'Here lived Spinoza, 1671–1677'.

days.bz: 上午在海牙郊外的美术馆，镜子前的雕塑、一架子小动物。下午到莱茵斯堡，斯宾诺莎在这里磨过镜片，小屋后面是花园。
days.be: A museum outside The Hague in the morning, a sculpture before a mirror and a shelf of little animals. Rijnsburg in the afternoon, where Spinoza ground lenses, a garden behind his cottage.

days.bz: 在阿姆斯特丹的国家博物馆，《夜巡》正在玻璃房里修复。又去了库伊珀斯图书馆，一层层的书架。
days.be: The Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam, The Night Watch under restoration in its glass room, and the Cuypers Library, gallery upon gallery of shelves.

days.bz: 上午在阿姆斯特丹的犹太博物馆，旁边的广场上有斯宾诺莎的雕像。下午到乌得勒支，在主教座堂一带看墙上的石碑。
days.be: The Jewish Museum in Amsterdam in the morning, with Spinoza's statue on the square nearby. Utrecht in the afternoon, and stones in the walls around the cathedral.

days.zh: 高费吕沃和奥斯特贝克
days.bz: 上午在高费吕沃国家公园的林子里，克勒勒-米勒美术馆里有梵高。下午到阿纳姆边上的奥斯特贝克，1944 年「市场花园」行动的空降博物馆，就在当年的哈滕斯坦酒店里。
days.be: The woods of the Hoge Veluwe in the morning, and Van Gogh at the Kröller-Müller Museum. Oosterbeek near Arnhem in the afternoon, the Airborne Museum of Operation Market Garden in the old Hartenstein hotel.

days.bz: 过了边境到德国的克桑滕，古罗马的城市遗址，展厅里有罗马道路图。傍晚到杜塞尔多夫，国王大道的运河边。
days.be: Over the border to Xanten in Germany and its Roman city, a Roman road map in the museum. Düsseldorf at dusk, by the canal on the Königsallee.

days.bz: 到亚琛，查理曼的八角礼拜堂顶上是金色的马赛克，后面是一整面彩色玻璃的唱诗堂。然后看了大教堂宝库。
days.be: Aachen: gold mosaics in Charlemagne's octagon, a whole choir of stained glass behind it, and then the cathedral treasury.

days.bz: 在马斯特里赫特，老教堂改成的书店。晚上弗莱特霍夫广场上正在开露天音乐会。
days.be: Maastricht, and a bookshop in an old Dominican church. An open-air concert on the Vrijthof at night.

days.bz: 中午在列日。下午到鲁汶，爬上大学图书馆的钟楼看城市；圣伯多禄教堂里挂着迪里克·鲍茨的《最后的晚餐》。
days.be: Liège at midday. Leuven in the afternoon: the city from the University Library tower, and Dieric Bouts' Last Supper in St Peter's Church.

days.bz: 最后一天在滑铁卢，1815 年的战场。爬上狮子丘，四周还是一片麦田。
days.be: A last day at Waterloo, the battlefield of 1815, up the Lion's Mound over fields still full of wheat.

title.zh: 首尔，和从殷墟到长江，2026 年春
title.en: Seoul, and from Yinxu to the Yangtze, spring 2026

lede.zh: 在首尔转机时上了南汉山城。回国后从安阳的殷墟、临漳的邺城、洛阳往南，经襄阳、武汉、九江、马鞍山的采石矶，一路顺长江到南京和镇江。
lede.en: Namhansanseong during a stopover in Seoul. Then south from Yinxu at Anyang, Yecheng at Linzhang and Luoyang, through Xiangyang, Wuhan, Jiujiang and Caishiji at Ma'anshan, and down the Yangtze to Nanjing and Zhenjiang.

days.bz: 在首尔转机，去了城南的南汉山城。1636 年丙子之役，朝鲜仁祖就在这座山城里被围了四十多天。山里的寺院正挂着佛诞节的灯笼。
days.be: A stopover in Seoul and a trip to the mountain fortress of Namhansanseong, where King Injo of Joseon was besieged for over forty days in 1636. Lanterns for the Buddha's Birthday were strung up in the temple.

days.bz: 中午在首尔的公园里走了走，然后飞上海。
days.be: A walk in a Seoul park at midday, then the flight to Shanghai.

days.bz: 到安阳。下午先去西高穴的曹操高陵，下到墓道里看墓室。傍晚到殷墟，商代晚期的都城，车马坑里还摆着马车，博物馆里满墙青铜器上的纹样。
days.be: Anyang. Cao Cao's Mausoleum at Xigaoxue in the afternoon, down the ramp to the tomb chambers. Yinxu, the late Shang capital, towards evening: chariots still in their pits, and the patterns of the bronzes filling the museum walls.

days.en: Yecheng and the Northern Dynasties tombs
days.bz: 上午在临漳的邺城遗址，曹操经营过的都城，后来又是东魏、北齐的京城，看了城市的复原模型。中午过漳河到磁县，北朝墓群里有东魏茹茹公主的墓，旁边的北朝考古博物馆里是高澄的展板、北朝壁画和一整排人物像。下午回到临漳县城的邺城博物馆，大殿前是一整面浮雕墙。
days.be: The ruins of Yecheng at Linzhang in the morning, the city Cao Cao built up and later the capital of the Eastern Wei and Northern Qi, with a model of the city. Across the Zhang River at midday to the Northern Dynasties tombs at Cixian, among them the tomb of the Rouran princess of the Eastern Wei, and the museum beside them: Gao Cheng, Northern Dynasties murals and a long row of figures. Back to the Yecheng Museum in Linzhang in the afternoon, a great relief wall before the hall.

days.zh: 白马寺、汉魏洛阳城和襄阳
days.en: White Horse Temple, Han–Wei Luoyang and Xiangyang
days.bz: 上午在洛阳城东的白马寺，然后去了汉魏洛阳城遗址，下着雨，遗址上的麦子已经黄了。下午往南到襄阳，晚上古城的昭明台和城门都亮着灯。
days.be: White Horse Temple east of Luoyang in the morning, then the ruins of Han–Wei Luoyang in the rain, the wheat on the site already gold. South to Xiangyang in the afternoon, the Zhaoming Tower and the gates of the old city lit up at night.

days.bz: 上午在襄阳城南的岘山，山上是纪念羊祜、杜预的祠，往北看得到整座襄阳城。中午到武汉，下午在江汉关博物馆，看汉口开埠、「东方芝加哥」的兴起和 1927 年收回英租界。
days.be: Xianshan south of Xiangyang in the morning, with its shrine to Yang Hu and Du Yu and the whole city spread out to the north. Wuhan by midday, and the Jianghan Customs House Museum in the afternoon: the opening of Hankou, its rise as the 'Chicago of the East', and the recovery of the British concession in 1927.

days.bz: 上午在湖北省博物馆又看了一次曾侯乙编钟。下午到九江，湖边的烟水亭，碑刻和石雕。
days.be: The bells of the Marquis Yi of Zeng once more at the Hubei Provincial Museum in the morning. Jiujiang in the afternoon: the pavilion on the lake, stelae and stone carvings.

days.bz: 到马鞍山的采石矶，长江边的石矶，传说李白就在这里捉月。山上有三公祠、三元洞和广济寺。
days.be: Caishiji at Ma'anshan, a rocky headland on the Yangtze where Li Bai is said to have drowned reaching for the moon. The Hall of the Three Lords, the Sanyuan Cave and Guangji Temple on the hill.

days.bz: 在南京。早上沿着城墙走，然后在一处处碑刻、石像和老石刻之间逛了一天。
days.be: Nanjing. Along the city wall in the morning, then a day among stelae, stone statues and old carvings.

days.bz: 最后一天在镇江，江边山上的碑林和龟趺碑，树林外就是长江。
days.be: A last day in Zhenjiang: a forest of stelae on the riverside hill, tortoise-borne stones, and the Yangtze beyond the trees.

title.zh: 纽约，为了《怀疑》，2026 年春

lede.zh: 排《怀疑》的时候去了一趟纽约。这部戏写的是 1964 年布朗克斯一所天主教学校，于是去看了曼哈顿的教会大学和老教堂，在大斋期的弥撒里坐了一个钟头，又去布朗克斯找了一座带学校的教堂。
lede.en: A trip to New York while directing Doubt. The play is set in a Catholic school in the Bronx in 1964, so I went to a Jesuit university and old churches in Manhattan, sat through a Lenten mass, and found a parish church with its school in the Bronx.

days.en: Fordham and St Paul the Apostle
days.bz: 在林肯中心一带，耶稣会的福特汉姆大学曼哈顿校区，街对面是灰色石头的圣保罗宗徒堂。
days.be: Around Lincoln Center: Fordham University's Manhattan campus, run by the Jesuits, and across the street the grey stone Church of St Paul the Apostle.

days.bz: 傍晚回到圣保罗宗徒堂，大斋期第五主日的弥撒，神父穿着紫色的祭衣。弥撒后在堂里看祭台、圣母像和墙上的马赛克。
days.be: Back at St Paul the Apostle in the evening for the Mass of the Fifth Sunday of Lent, the priest in violet. Afterwards the altar, the Madonna and the mosaics along the walls.

days.bz: 上午去布朗克斯，找到一座红砖的天主教堂，旁边就是教会学校，院子里立着圣母像。下午在格林威治村，傍晚走进第五大道的圣帕特里克大教堂。
days.be: The Bronx in the morning, and a red-brick parish church with its school next door and a Madonna in the yard. Greenwich Village in the afternoon, and St Patrick's Cathedral on Fifth Avenue at dusk.

title.zh: 爪哇、新加坡、马来西亚，2025–26 年跨年
title.en: Java, Singapore and Malaysia, New Year 2025–26

lede.zh: 从泗水上布罗莫火山看日出，坐火车穿过爪哇到日惹、万隆和雅加达；然后是新加坡，再从吉隆坡往北到槟城，往南到马六甲。
lede.en: Sunrise on Mount Bromo from Surabaya, then by train across Java to Yogyakarta, Bandung and Jakarta; on to Singapore, and from Kuala Lumpur north to Penang and south to Malacca.

days.bz: 飞了一整天，傍晚落地泗水，晚上走收费公路往山里开。
days.be: A whole day of flying, landing in Surabaya at dusk, and up the toll road towards the mountains at night.

days.bz: 天没亮就上山，在雾里爬到布罗莫火山口，火山口还冒着白烟，对面是巴托克山。下午回到泗水，看了郑和清真寺。
days.be: Up before dawn, climbing through the mist to the rim of Bromo, the crater still steaming, Mount Batok across the sand sea. Back in Surabaya in the afternoon, and the Cheng Ho Mosque.

days.bz: 一早坐火车往西，窗外是香蕉林和稻田。下午到日惹，在街边小店吃炒饭和空心菜。
days.be: An early train west, banana groves and paddy fields outside the window. Yogyakarta in the afternoon, fried rice and water spinach at a street stall.

days.zh: 婆罗浮屠、普兰巴南和水宫
days.en: Borobudur, Prambanan and the Water Castle
days.bz: 上午在婆罗浮屠，一层层回廊上刻满了佛传故事的浮雕。中午到印度教的普兰巴南，尖塔一座挨着一座。下午回到日惹城里，从王宫外走到苏丹的水宫，傍晚在城里的一片老墓地。
days.be: Borobudur in the morning, gallery after gallery carved with the life of the Buddha. The Hindu temples of Prambanan at noon, spire after spire. Back in Yogyakarta in the afternoon, from outside the Kraton to the sultans' Water Castle, and an old cemetery in town towards evening.

days.bz: 又坐一天火车，穿过爪哇中部的梯田和村子，傍晚到万隆。
days.be: Another day on the train through the terraces and villages of central Java, reaching Bandung at dusk.

days.bz: 在万隆的亚非会议博物馆，1955 年 4 月 24 日闭幕的那次会议就在这座独立大厦里开。展厅里有各国代表的照片、会场的座位图和会议的文件。
days.be: The Museum of the Asian-African Conference in Bandung, in the Gedung Merdeka where the 1955 conference closed on 24 April: portraits of the delegates, the seating plan and the conference papers.

days.bz: 新年第一天，坐雅万高铁到雅加达。傍晚在老城区，荷兰时代的市政厅前坐满了人。
days.be: New Year's Day, and the Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway. The old town at dusk, crowds sitting out in front of the Dutch-era city hall.

days.bz: 在高楼上看雅加达，阴天，一片玻璃楼一直铺到天边。
days.be: Jakarta from high up on a grey day, glass towers to the horizon.

days.bz: 在市中心的商场里逛手工艺店，木雕、皮影、面具摆满了架子。
days.be: Craft shops in a downtown mall, shelves of woodcarving, shadow puppets and masks.

days.bz: 到新加坡。在高处看城市和一片片绿地，晚上去书店翻中文书。
days.be: Singapore: the city and its green spaces from up high, and Chinese books in a bookshop at night.

days.bz: 阴天里的滨海湾金沙。
days.be: Marina Bay Sands under cloud.

days.bz: 在圣淘沙的西乐索炮台，海岸炮对着新加坡海峡。展厅里复原了 1942 年英军投降的那一幕。
days.be: Fort Siloso on Sentosa, coastal guns trained on the Singapore Strait, and inside, a re-creation of the British surrender of 1942.

days.bz: 傍晚看了关于新加坡独立的展览「信天翁档案」，从 1963 年加入马来西亚，到 1965 年分家，一个月一个月倒数。
days.be: The Albatross File in the evening, an exhibition on how Singapore came to independence, counting down month by month from joining Malaysia in 1963 to the separation of 1965.

days.bz: 开车过海峡到吉隆坡，在高楼上看城市和远处的双子塔。
days.be: Across the causeway and up to Kuala Lumpur, the city and the distant towers from high up.

days.bz: 在马来西亚国家博物馆，屋顶是马来式的，正面贴着一整面马赛克壁画。馆里有老地图、锡矿的老照片和爪夷文的手抄本。下午开车北上，晚上到槟城。
days.be: The National Museum of Malaysia, with a Malay roof and a whole mosaic mural across the front: old maps, photographs of the tin mines and Jawi manuscripts inside. North by car in the afternoon, reaching Penang at night.

days.bz: 在槟城。宗祠里满是金色的雕刻，姓氏桥的木栈道伸进海里。又去了娘惹博物馆，街角有骑单车的孩子壁画，木椅上睡着一只猫。下午一路往南，晚上到马六甲。
days.be: Penang: a clan house full of gilded carving, the plank walks of the clan jetties running out to sea, the Peranakan Mansion, a mural of children on a bicycle, and a cat asleep on a carved chair. South all afternoon, reaching Malacca at night.

days.bz: 最后一天在马六甲，圣保罗山上的荷兰墓碑，马六甲河，还有纪念郑和下西洋在这里驻扎的碑。
days.be: A last day in Malacca: Dutch tombstones on St Paul's Hill, the Malacca River, and a stone marking Zheng He's fleet stopping here.

title.zh: 英国和爱尔兰，2025 年冬

lede.zh: 在伦敦住了五天，然后租车自驾：多佛、坎特伯雷、朴次茅斯、巨石阵、巴斯、牛津、沃里克、利物浦、曼彻斯特、约克郡、哈德良长城和诺森伯兰，一路开到苏格兰；最后从都柏林往西南到科克，再到莫赫悬崖和康尼马拉。
lede.en: Five days in London, then a hire car: Dover, Canterbury, Portsmouth, Stonehenge, Bath, Oxford, Warwick, Liverpool, Manchester, Yorkshire, Hadrian's Wall and Northumberland, all the way up to Scotland; and finally from Dublin down to Cork, then out to the Cliffs of Moher and Connemara.

days.bz: 第一天就在大英博物馆。亚述宫殿的浮雕、罗塞塔石碑，楼上还有日本的佛画、浮世绘和伊斯兰的星形瓷砖。
days.be: A first day at the British Museum: the Assyrian palace reliefs, the Rosetta Stone, and upstairs Japanese Buddhist paintings, ukiyo-e and Islamic star tiles.

days.zh: 圣詹姆斯公园和威斯敏斯特
days.bz: 上午穿过圣詹姆斯公园，湖边的鹈鹕就在路上散步，走到白金汉宫门口。下午在威斯敏斯特教堂，晚上去科文特花园看圣诞装饰。
days.be: Through St James's Park in the morning, its pelicans strolling on the path, to the gates of Buckingham Palace. Westminster Abbey in the afternoon, and Covent Garden's Christmas decorations at night.

days.bz: 在城西逛书店和唱片店，然后穿过一大片公园，下午在博物馆里看老地图和肖像。
days.be: Bookshops and record shops in west London, then across a great park, and old maps and portraits in a museum in the afternoon.

days.bz: 上午在伦敦塔，城墙、护城河和一段一段的历史展板。然后沿河走到伦敦桥。
days.be: The Tower of London in the morning: walls, moat and panel after panel of history. Then along the river to London Bridge.

days.bz: 上午在狄更斯故居博物馆。下午去泰晤士河上游的汉普顿宫，亨利八世的宫殿，门楼上有一座天文钟。
days.be: The Charles Dickens Museum in the morning. Hampton Court up the Thames in the afternoon, Henry VIII's palace, an astronomical clock over its gate.

days.bz: 上午在南丁格尔博物馆。下午取了车，开出伦敦，天黑时到温莎，城堡下的街上挂满了圣诞灯。
days.be: The Florence Nightingale Museum in the morning. In the afternoon, the hire car and out of London, reaching Windsor after dark, the streets under the castle hung with Christmas lights.

days.zh: 白崖、雷卡尔弗和坎特伯雷
days.bz: 清晨在多佛的海边，然后到圣玛格丽特湾，白崖直接落进海里。上午到北岸的雷卡尔弗，海边立着中世纪教堂的一对塔和罗马要塞的残墙。下午在坎特伯雷，先看圣奥古斯丁修道院的遗址，再进大教堂，满墙中世纪的彩色玻璃。
days.be: The sea at Dover at dawn, then St Margaret's Bay, the white cliffs dropping straight into the water. Reculver on the north coast in the morning, the twin towers of a medieval church and the walls of a Roman fort by the sea. Canterbury in the afternoon: the ruins of St Augustine's Abbey, then the cathedral, walls of medieval stained glass.

days.bz: 上午在朴次茅斯的历史船坞，纳尔逊的旗舰胜利号还停在干船坞里。下午开到索尔兹伯里平原，雨里的巨石阵。
days.be: Portsmouth's historic dockyard in the morning, Nelson's flagship HMS Victory still in its dry dock. Across Salisbury Plain in the afternoon, and Stonehenge in the rain.

days.bz: 早上在巴斯。下午到牛津，一直在阿什莫林博物馆：埃及的石刻、罗马马赛克、浮世绘、一整面墙的瓷器，还有意大利的祭坛画。
days.be: Bath in the morning. Oxford in the afternoon, and the Ashmolean until closing: Egyptian stonework, a Roman mosaic, ukiyo-e, a whole wall of porcelain and Italian altarpieces.

days.zh: 沃里克城堡和巴德斯利·克林顿
days.bz: 到沃里克城堡，爬上城墙看埃文河，礼拜堂里是彩色玻璃和博尚家族的纹章。下午到附近的巴德斯利·克林顿，一座围着护城河的都铎时代庄园，屋里已经摆上了圣诞树。
days.be: Warwick Castle, up on the walls above the Avon, stained glass and the Beauchamp arms in the chapel. Baddesley Clinton nearby in the afternoon, a moated Tudor manor with its Christmas tree already up.

days.bz: 上午在利物浦，码头边在修船坞；博物馆里有辛格双胞胎姐妹的画，中午去了唐人街。傍晚到曼彻斯特，唐人街的牌楼亮着灯。
days.be: Liverpool in the morning, a dock under repair on the waterfront, the Singh Twins' art in the museum, and Chinatown at midday. Manchester by evening, its Chinatown arch lit up.

days.zh: 勃朗特故居和马斯顿荒原
days.bz: 翻过奔宁山到霍沃思，勃朗特三姐妹的牧师住宅，屋后就是墓园。下午到马斯顿荒原，1644 年英国内战最大的一场战役就在这片田里。
days.be: Over the Pennines to Haworth and the Brontës' parsonage, the churchyard right behind it. Marston Moor in the afternoon, where the largest battle of the English Civil War was fought in 1644.

days.zh: 斯卡伯勒、惠特比和哈德良长城
days.bz: 上午在斯卡伯勒，安妮·勃朗特就葬在这里的教堂墓园。然后沿海岸到惠特比，悬崖上的修道院只剩下骨架。下午横穿英格兰北部，到哈德良长城。
days.be: Scarborough in the morning, where Anne Brontë lies in the churchyard. Along the coast to Whitby, its abbey on the cliff reduced to a skeleton. Across the north of England in the afternoon to Hadrian's Wall.

days.bz: 上午在诺森伯兰的沃克沃思城堡，然后往北到班堡城堡，城堡里摆满了圣诞装饰，城墙上看得到沙丘和北海。傍晚进苏格兰，到爱丁堡。
days.be: Warkworth Castle in Northumberland in the morning, then north to Bamburgh Castle, dressed for Christmas, the dunes and the North Sea from its walls. Into Scotland and Edinburgh by evening.

days.bz: 进了苏格兰。中午在斯特灵的华莱士纪念塔，山下是老斯特灵桥。傍晚到爱丁堡，老城已经亮起了圣诞灯。
days.be: Into Scotland. The Wallace Monument at Stirling at midday, the old Stirling Bridge below. Edinburgh by evening, the old town lit for Christmas.

days.bz: 在爱丁堡的皇家英里大道，圣吉尔斯大教堂的彩色玻璃。下午在苏格兰国家博物馆。
days.be: The Royal Mile, and stained glass in St Giles' Cathedral. The National Museum of Scotland in the afternoon.

days.bz: 到都柏林。国家博物馆里是爱尔兰的金器和维京时代的展。下午在圣帕特里克大教堂。
days.be: Dublin: Irish gold and the Viking age at the National Museum, and St Patrick's Cathedral in the afternoon.

days.bz: 往西南到基尔肯尼城堡，奥蒙德家族的城堡，长长的画廊顶上是彩绘的木梁。晚上到科克。
days.be: Southwest to Kilkenny Castle, seat of the Ormonds, its long picture gallery under painted beams. Cork by night.

days.bz: 横穿爱尔兰到西海岸的莫赫悬崖，两百米高的崖壁一直排到海天之间，大西洋的浪拍在下面。
days.be: Across Ireland to the Cliffs of Moher on the west coast, two hundred metres of rock marching off into the haze, the Atlantic breaking below.

days.bz: 最后一天在康尼马拉的凯尔莫尔修道院，湖边的城堡，林子里有围墙花园和修女的墓地。晚上开回都柏林。
days.be: A last day at Kylemore Abbey in Connemara, a castle by a lake, with a walled garden and the nuns' graveyard in the woods. Back to Dublin at night.

lede.zh: 昆西、普利茅斯、科德角、波士顿、塞勒姆、康科德、列克星敦：五天里走了一遍殖民地和独立战争的开头。
lede.en: Quincy, Plymouth, Cape Cod, Boston, Salem, Concord and Lexington: five days through the colony and the opening of the Revolution.

days.bz: 一早在昆西。上午到普利茅斯，上了复制的五月花二号，看了刻着「1620」的普利茅斯岩和殖民地的复原村落。下午沿科德角往外开，在海恩尼斯看了海事博物馆，傍晚到最尖上的普罗温斯敦。
days.be: Quincy first thing. Plymouth in the morning: aboard the replica Mayflower II, Plymouth Rock with its '1620', and the re-created colony village. Out along Cape Cod in the afternoon, a maritime museum at Hyannis, and Provincetown at the very tip by dusk.

days.zh: 加德纳博物馆和塞勒姆
days.bz: 上午在波士顿的伊莎贝拉·斯图尔特·加德纳博物馆，威尼斯式的中庭里种满了花。下午到塞勒姆，女巫审判的纪念地、老教堂，还有城市创建者罗杰·科南特的铜像。
days.be: The Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum in Boston in the morning, its Venetian courtyard full of flowers. Salem in the afternoon: the witch trials memorial, an old church, and the statue of the town's founder, Roger Conant.

days.bz: 在康科德的瓦尔登湖，梭罗小屋的复原和旁边的柴棚，林子外就是湖。傍晚到《小妇人》作者奥尔科特一家的果园屋。
days.be: Walden Pond in Concord: the replica of Thoreau's cabin and its woodshed, the pond through the trees. Orchard House, home of the Alcotts of Little Women, at dusk.

days.bz: 沿着 1775 年 4 月 19 日英军走过的路，从康科德的老北桥一带走到列克星敦，路边的石头上钉着一块块铜牌。傍晚开到北岸的格洛斯特海边。
days.be: Along the road the British marched on 19 April 1775, from around Concord's Old North Bridge to Lexington, bronze plaques bolted to boulders by the way. The North Shore at Gloucester by evening.

days.bz: 最后一天在波士顿查尔斯敦的海军船坞，看了「老铁甲」宪法号，1797 年下水，至今还是现役。
days.be: A last day at the Charlestown Navy Yard in Boston, and 'Old Ironsides', USS Constitution, launched in 1797 and still in commission.

lede.zh: 开着房车在阿拉斯加转了一圈：从安克雷奇往北到费尔班克斯，沿理查森公路南下到瓦尔迪兹，再经马塔努斯卡冰川回来，最后去惠蒂尔和苏厄德的出口冰川。
lede.en: A loop of Alaska in a camper van: north from Anchorage to Fairbanks, down the Richardson Highway to Valdez, back past the Matanuska Glacier, and finally to Whittier and Exit Glacier at Seward.

days.bz: 晚上飞到安克雷奇，机场里有一只抱着鱼的铜熊。八月的阿拉斯加，快十点天还亮着。
days.be: An evening flight into Anchorage, a bronze bear clutching a fish in the terminal. Alaska in August, still light at nearly ten.

days.bz: 取了房车，下午在安克雷奇北边的山上走，云从山谷里一层层升起来，石头缝里开着蓝色的风铃草。晚上看了一条藏在林子里的瀑布。
days.be: The camper van, then an afternoon walk in the hills north of Anchorage, cloud rising out of the valley layer by layer, harebells in the cracks of the rock. A waterfall hidden in the woods in the evening.

days.bz: 上午在湖边，然后开上哈彻山口，山谷里全是苔原和野花，雾一直压在山顶。傍晚在溪边停车。
days.be: A lake in the morning, then up to Hatcher Pass, the valleys all tundra and wildflowers, fog pressing on the summits. A stop by a creek at dusk.

days.bz: 沿着帕克斯公路往北，辫状的冰川河铺满了河谷，远处是阿拉斯加山脉。下午在飓风峡谷的桥上往下看，傍晚开到德纳里国家公园一带的尼纳纳河谷。
days.be: North on the Parks Highway, braided glacial rivers filling the valleys and the Alaska Range beyond. Looking down from the bridge over Hurricane Gulch in the afternoon, and the Nenana valley near Denali National Park by evening.

days.bz: 中午到了费尔班克斯北边，下午沿着奇纳河往东。傍晚往南开，晚上九点在塔纳纳河的河滩上看野鸭晒太阳。
days.be: North of Fairbanks at midday, then east along the Chena River in the afternoon. South again towards evening, and at nine o'clock, ducks sunning themselves on the bank of the Tanana.

days.bz: 掉头沿理查森公路往南，路边长着大蘑菇。穿过阿拉斯加山脉，在卡斯特纳冰川的冰碛上走了走；傍晚过了萨米特湖。
days.be: Turning south on the Richardson Highway, big mushrooms by the road. Across the Alaska Range, a walk on the moraine of the Castner Glacier, and past Summit Lake in the evening.

days.zh: 沃辛顿冰川和瓦尔迪兹
days.bz: 下午走到沃辛顿冰川跟前，石头上长着黄绿色的苔藓。然后穿过基斯通峡谷，新娘面纱瀑布从崖上挂下来，到瓦尔迪兹。
days.be: Up to the foot of the Worthington Glacier in the afternoon, yellow-green moss on the stones. Then through Keystone Canyon, Bridal Veil Falls hanging off the cliff, down to Valdez.

days.bz: 从格伦公路往回开，路过马塔努斯卡冰川，山谷里是一条条分叉的河。晚上开回到海湾边。
days.be: Back along the Glenn Highway, past the Matanuska Glacier and its valley of braided channels. Down to the inlet by nightfall.

days.bz: 沿着特纳根湾往南，观景台上画着白鲸。下午穿过去惠蒂尔的单车道隧道，河滩上躺着洄游的鲑鱼，晚上停在瀑布下。
days.be: South along Turnagain Arm, belugas painted on the viewpoint. Through the one-lane tunnel to Whittier in the afternoon, spawned salmon on the gravel, and a night under a waterfall.

days.bz: 在苏厄德的出口冰川，路边立着年份牌，标着冰川每年退到了哪里。然后开回安克雷奇。
days.be: Exit Glacier at Seward, with year markers along the trail showing where the ice once reached. Then the drive back to Anchorage.

title.zh: 台湾、香港、上海、杭州，2025 年春
title.en: Taiwan, Hong Kong, Shanghai and Hangzhou, spring 2025

lede.zh: 台北逛书店，回高雄看看读过书的地方，然后经香港到上海，最后在杭州西湖边走了一晚。
lede.en: Bookshops in Taipei, a return to where I once studied in Kaohsiung, then Hong Kong and Shanghai, and a last evening by the West Lake in Hangzhou.

days.bz: 到台北，在书店里泡了一下午，一架一架的繁体书。
days.be: Taipei, and an afternoon lost in bookshops, shelf after shelf of books in traditional characters.

days.en: The Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall and Dharma Drum Mountain
days.bz: 上午在台北 101 下面，走到国父纪念馆，园子里有中山碑林。下午去北海岸金山的法鼓山，圣严法师开山的道场，清水池映着红砖的殿。
days.be: Under Taipei 101 in the morning, then the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall and the Zhongshan stele garden in its grounds. Dharma Drum Mountain at Jinshan on the north coast in the afternoon, the monastery Master Sheng Yen founded, its red-brick halls reflected in a still pool.

days.bz: 上午在台北的龙山寺，然后坐高铁一路往南到高雄。下午在凤山的大东文化艺术中心，白色的膜结构像一片片帐篷。
days.be: Longshan Temple in Taipei in the morning, then the high-speed rail south to Kaohsiung. The Dadong Arts Center in Fengshan in the afternoon, its white membrane roofs like a row of tents.

days.bz: 回到十年前读过书的地方，草地上躺着一只狗，教室还是老样子。中午去了佛陀纪念馆，晚上在港边。
days.be: Back where I studied a decade ago: a dog asleep on the grass, the classrooms just as they were. The Buddha Museum at midday, and the harbour at night.

days.bz: 到香港，在中环下车，街上跑着双层电车和巴士，下午在书店里翻书，傍晚在铜锣湾。
days.be: Hong Kong: off at Central, trams and double-deckers in the street, an afternoon of books, and Causeway Bay at dusk.

days.bz: 在高处看香港，楼挤到山脚下。
days.be: Hong Kong from up high, the towers crowding to the foot of the hills.

days.bz: 在上海，从外滩对岸的陆家嘴走到黄浦江边，草地上有一块纪念犹太难民的铭牌。
days.be: Shanghai, from Lujiazui to the Huangpu, and on the grass a plaque remembering the Jewish refugees.

days.en: The Pearl Tower in the fog
days.bz: 早上起来，东方明珠泡在雾里。
days.be: Morning, and the Oriental Pearl Tower drowned in fog.

days.bz: 到杭州，傍晚在西湖边，柳浪闻莺、林启先生祠、张煌言墓，天黑后雷峰塔亮起来。
days.be: Hangzhou, and an evening on the West Lake: the Orioles Singing in the Willows, the shrine of Lin Qi, the tomb of Zhang Huangyan, and Leifeng Pagoda lit up after dark.

lede.zh: 伊斯坦布尔、布尔萨、加里波利、特洛伊、阿索斯、帕加马、以弗所、棉花堡、萨加拉索斯、安塔利亚、锡德、科尼亚、卡帕多奇亚、开塞利、塔尔苏斯、安塔基亚、加济安泰普、尚勒乌尔法、迪亚巴克尔、凡湖、卡尔斯、阿尼、埃尔祖鲁姆、锡瓦斯、阿马西亚、黑海沿岸、苏美拉修道院、特拉布宗。
lede.en: Istanbul, Bursa, Gallipoli, Troy, Assos, Pergamon, Ephesus, Pamukkale, Sagalassos, Antalya, Side, Konya, Cappadocia, Kayseri, Tarsus, Antakya, Gaziantep, Şanlıurfa, Diyarbakır, Lake Van, Kars, Ani, Erzurum, Sivas, Amasya, the Black Sea coast, Sumela and Trabzon.

2.zh: 地中海与安纳托利亚腹地

days.bz: 第一天下午先到博斯普鲁斯海峡边，傍晚进了圣索菲亚大教堂，看二楼回廊里的科穆宁马赛克。第二天在老城：托卡帕宫一进进院落看下来，内廷的亭阁贴满伊兹尼克瓷砖；考古博物馆的院子里摆着一排排石棺和柱头；还看了一座很大的城市模型，能把整座伊斯坦布尔看个大概。街上到处是晒太阳的猫和狗。
days.be: The first afternoon by the Bosphorus, then Hagia Sophia at dusk and the Komnenos mosaic in the upper gallery. The second day in the old city: Topkapı Palace court by court, the kiosks of the inner palace lined with İznik tiles; rows of sarcophagi and capitals in the Archaeology Museum's garden; and a huge scale model that lays out the whole of Istanbul. Cats and dogs sunning themselves on every street.

days.bz: 上午在伊斯坦布尔亚洲岸，去了一家玩具博物馆，橱窗里是飞艇、锡兵和旧报纸摆出来的一战。中午取车往南，开到布尔萨。下午在布尔萨城市博物馆，从奥斯曼帝国在这里建都讲起，还原了一间间老作坊。傍晚走到托普哈内的钟楼和城墙，天黑时城门亮起了灯。
days.be: A morning on Istanbul's Asian side, at a toy museum whose cases stage the First World War in airships, tin soldiers and old newspapers. At noon, the car, and south to Bursa. In the afternoon, the Bursa City Museum, which begins with the Ottoman state founding its capital here and rebuilds a street of old workshops. At dusk, the clock tower and walls at Tophane, the gate lit up as night fell.

days.bz: 早上在布尔萨考古博物馆，院子里摆满了石刻。然后一路往西，开到达达尼尔海峡边的加里波利半岛。1915 年的战场如今是一片松林里的纪念区：野炮、纪念碑、写着各师伤亡人数的铭牌，展厅里讲恰纳卡莱上空的空战。纪念区里有好几只大狗，懒洋洋地趴在草地上。晚上住到海峡南边的盖伊克利。
days.be: Morning at the Bursa Archaeology Museum, its yard full of carved stones. Then west all the way to the Gallipoli peninsula on the Dardanelles. The 1915 battlefields are now memorial grounds among the pines: field guns, monuments, plaques giving each division's losses, and a hall on the air war over Çanakkale. Several big dogs lay about on the grass. Overnight at Geyikli, south of the strait.

days.bz: 上午在特洛伊，一层层城址叠在一起，发掘沟里能看到不同年代的城墙，门口还有一只大狗领路；特洛伊博物馆里有早年发掘的老照片。下午往南到阿索斯，雅典娜神庙建在海边的山顶上，脚下就是爱琴海，对面是莱斯沃斯岛。遗址里的说明牌列着阿索斯的名人，亚里士多德曾在这里住过几年。傍晚在亚历山大特罗亚斯遗址转了一圈，回到盖伊克利。
days.be: The morning at Troy, city on city, the trenches showing walls from different ages, with a large dog as guide at the gate; the Troy Museum has photographs of the early digs. In the afternoon, south to Assos, where the Temple of Athena sits on a hilltop over the Aegean, with Lesbos across the water. A board among the ruins lists the famous residents; Aristotle lived here for a few years. At dusk, a walk around the ruins of Alexandria Troas, and back to Geyikli.

days.bz: 上午路过海边的艾瓦勒克。中午到贝尔加马，先看考古博物馆里的铭文和祭坛，然后是医神庙阿斯克勒庇恩，一排排断柱立在草地上。下午上卫城，图拉真神庙的白色柱子对着整个山谷，剧场陡得像挂在山坡上。晚上住阿利阿加。
days.be: Through Ayvalık on the coast in the morning. At noon, Bergama: inscriptions and altars in the Archaeology Museum, then the Asklepion, rows of broken columns standing in the grass. In the afternoon, up to the acropolis, the white columns of the Temple of Trajan facing the whole valley, and a theatre so steep it seems to hang on the hillside. Overnight in Aliağa.

days.bz: 早上在伊兹密尔，考古博物馆里的马赛克和钱币。然后往南到塞尔丘克，下午整个都在以弗所：大剧场、大理石铺的库瑞忒斯大街、一路的说明牌。遗址里的狗很多。傍晚在塞尔丘克的圣约翰大教堂遗址，有一只狗就站在一堆柱头中间。晚上住塞尔丘克。
days.be: Morning in İzmir, for the mosaics and coins in the Archaeology Museum. Then south to Selçuk, and the whole afternoon at Ephesus: the Great Theatre, the marble-paved Curetes Street, one information board after another. Plenty of dogs among the ruins. At dusk, the Basilica of St John in Selçuk, where one dog stood among a pile of capitals. Overnight in Selçuk.

days.bz: 一整天在赫拉波利斯。阴天，剧场的舞台立面修复得很完整，从上面往下看尤其壮观。沿着古城的主街和城门走了一圈，城里的博物馆放在罗马浴场的拱顶下，有提水的仙女像和一位医官的雕像。棉花堡的石灰华梯田就在古城脚下。
days.be: A whole day at Hierapolis under a grey sky. The theatre's stage front has been restored almost whole and is best seen from the top rows. A loop along the main street and gates, and the museum set under the vaults of the Roman baths, with its water-carrying nymph and a statue of a physician. The travertine terraces of Pamukkale lie just below the ancient city.

days.bz: 上午在拉奥迪凯亚，《启示录》里写信去的七个教会之一，说明牌上印着那封信。遗址很大，剧场正在修复。然后往东到布尔杜尔，博物馆里讲附近基比拉古城的出土，还有一整面罗马皇帝的年表。下午的因苏尤溶洞外已经积了雪。晚上住伊斯帕尔塔。
days.be: The morning at Laodicea, one of the seven churches written to in Revelation, the letter printed on a board by the ruins. A large site, its theatre under restoration. Then east to Burdur, whose museum covers the finds from nearby Kibyra and has a whole wall of Roman emperors. By the afternoon, snow had settled at the mouth of İnsuyu Cave. Overnight in Isparta.

days.zh: 雪中的萨加拉索斯，特尔梅索斯
days.bz: 早上上山去萨加拉索斯，一夜大雪，整座古城都埋在白色里。然后往南下到海边，中午在特尔梅索斯，山谷里起了雾，石棺和神庙的残墙散在树林中。下午到安塔利亚博物馆，佩尔格出土的雕像摆满了展厅。
days.be: Up to Sagalassos in the morning, after a night of heavy snow that had buried the whole city in white. Then south towards the coast, and Termessos at noon, mist in the valley, sarcophagi and temple walls scattered through the woods. In the afternoon, the Antalya Museum, its halls full of statues from Perge.

days.zh: 佩尔格、阿斯潘多斯、锡德
days.bz: 上午在佩尔格，城门的塔楼和长长的列柱街。中午到阿斯潘多斯，罗马剧场保存得几乎完整，旁边的高架引水渠延伸到远处。傍晚到海边的锡德，古城就在半岛上，剧场挨着现代的小镇。这天也要工作。
days.be: The morning at Perge, its gate towers and long colonnaded street. At noon, Aspendos, the Roman theatre almost intact and the aqueduct striding away beyond it. At dusk, Side on its peninsula, the ancient theatre right up against the modern town. A work day too.

days.zh: 贝伊谢希尔、锡莱、科尼亚
days.bz: 翻过托罗斯山。中午在贝伊谢希尔，塞尔柱时代的木柱清真寺，米哈拉布贴满了蓝绿色的瓷砖。下午先到科尼亚城外的锡莱，看了圣海伦娜教堂，然后进城：卡拉塔伊神学院的瓷砖穹顶，梅夫拉纳博物馆里鲁米的陵墓。
days.be: Over the Taurus. At noon, the Seljuk wooden-columned mosque at Beyşehir, its mihrab covered in blue-green tiles. In the afternoon, first Sille outside Konya and its Church of St Helena, then into the city: the tiled dome of the Karatay Madrasa, and Rumi's tomb in the Mevlana Museum.

days.bz: 上午在苏丹哈讷商队驿站，高大的石门，里面现在展着地毯。中午到塞利梅，岩壁里凿出来的修道院，一层层房间。然后是伊赫拉拉峡谷，下午钻进地下城，通道窄得要弯腰。晚上住乌奇希萨尔。
days.be: The morning at the Sultanhanı caravanserai, its towering stone gate, carpets now on show inside. At noon, Selime, a monastery carved storey by storey into the cliff. Then the Ihlara Valley, and in the afternoon an underground city, its passages low enough to make you stoop. Overnight in Uçhisar.

days.bz: 上午在乌奇希萨尔城堡。然后是格雷梅露天博物馆，岩洞教堂里的壁画还保留着颜色，基督像在拱顶上。下午去了泽尔维，一整片被废弃的岩洞村落。傍晚开到开塞利。
days.be: The morning at Uçhisar Castle. Then the Göreme Open Air Museum, where the rock-cut churches still keep their colour, Christ in the vault overhead. In the afternoon, Zelve, a whole abandoned village of caves. On to Kayseri at dusk.

days.bz: 上午在开塞利，塞尔柱文明博物馆和老城墙。然后往南翻过托罗斯山，雪山下就是乞里乞亚门。傍晚到塔尔苏斯，使徒保罗的故乡，老街上的保罗咖啡馆，博物馆里的石碑，巷子里有人在喂一群猫。晚上住阿达纳。
days.be: Kayseri in the morning, for the Seljuk Civilisation Museum and the old walls. Then south over the Taurus, the Cilician Gates beneath the snowy peaks. At dusk, Tarsus, the apostle Paul's home town: a St Paul café on the old street, steles in the museum, a man feeding a crowd of cats in an alley. Overnight in Adana.

days.zh: 阿达纳，沿海到安塔基亚
days.en: Adana, and the coast to Antakya
days.bz: 新年第一天。上午在阿达纳博物馆，从赫梯的石碑到一战后的阿达纳。中午爬上山顶的蛇堡。下午沿着哈塔伊的海岸往南，海水很蓝，山一直伸到海边。晚上到安塔基亚。
days.be: New Year's Day. The Adana Museum in the morning, from Hittite steles to Adana after the First World War. At noon, up to the Snake Castle on its crag. In the afternoon, south along the Hatay coast, the sea very blue and the mountains running right down to it. Antakya by night.

days.bz: 上午在安塔基亚，博物馆酒店的地下保留着整片古城遗址，玻璃栈道下就是马赛克地面。然后去圣彼得教堂，山崖里凿出的洞穴教堂，据说是最早的教堂之一。城里还是 2023 年地震后的样子，到处是瓦砾。下午开到加济安泰普。
days.be: Morning in Antakya, where a museum hotel preserves a whole excavated quarter under its floors, mosaics beneath the glass walkways. Then the Church of St Peter, a cave church cut into the cliff and said to be one of the first. The city still looks as the 2023 earthquake left it, rubble everywhere. On to Gaziantep in the afternoon.

days.zh: 泽乌玛马赛克，科马基尼
days.bz: 上午在加济安泰普，先是一座讲这座城市近代历史的博物馆，然后是泽乌玛马赛克博物馆：海神俄刻阿诺斯和忒提斯、圆框里的人像、一整面墙的几何纹样。下午往东到阿德亚曼，看佩雷古城，然后在内姆鲁特山脚下，看科马基尼王国留下的石像。
days.be: Gaziantep in the morning: first a museum on the city's modern history, then the Zeugma Mosaic Museum, with Oceanus and Tethys, a face in a roundel and a whole wall of geometric pattern. In the afternoon, east to Adıyaman for the ancient city of Perre, then, at the foot of Mount Nemrut, the stone figures the kingdom of Commagene left behind.

days.zh: 尚勒乌尔法和哥贝克力石阵
days.bz: 上午在尚勒乌尔法考古博物馆：一万多年前的石柱、刻着人形的石碑、复原的发掘现场，还有哈莱普利巴赫切出土的狩猎马赛克。中午在城里吃饭。下午到哥贝克力石阵，看目前已知最古老的神殿遗址，遗址外的狗都在晒着太阳睡觉。晚上开到迪亚巴克尔。
days.be: The Şanlıurfa Archaeology Museum in the morning: pillars more than ten thousand years old, a stone carved with a human figure, reconstructed excavations, and the hunting mosaic from Haleplibahçe. Lunch in town. In the afternoon, Göbekli Tepe, the oldest temple site yet known, the dogs outside asleep in the sun. On to Diyarbakır at night.

days.bz: 早上在迪亚巴克尔的黑色玄武岩城墙下。然后往东，路过塞尔柱时代的马拉巴迪古桥，一道拱跨过河谷。中午开到凡湖边，湖水灰蓝，对岸的山都白了。下午坐船上阿克达玛岛，看圣十字教堂墙上的浮雕，岛上的野兔一点也不怕人。晚上住凡城。
days.be: Morning under the black basalt walls of Diyarbakır. Then east, past the Seljuk Malabadi Bridge, one arch leaping the valley. At noon, the shore of Lake Van, the water grey-blue and the hills beyond all white. In the afternoon, a boat to Akdamar and the reliefs on the Church of the Holy Cross, the island's hares not at all shy. Overnight in Van.

days.bz: 早上凡城下了雪。然后往北，中午到曼齐刻尔特，1071 年拜占庭和塞尔柱在这里交战，现在有一座纪念博物馆。下午一路开过雪原，路上几乎没有车，傍晚的山口已经结了冰。晚上到卡尔斯。
days.be: Snow in Van in the morning. Then north, and at noon Malazgirt, where Byzantium and the Seljuks fought in 1071, now marked by a memorial museum. All afternoon across snowfields on a nearly empty road, the passes icing over by evening. Kars at night.

days.bz: 上午在阿尼古城，中世纪亚美尼亚的都城，就在和亚美尼亚交界的峡谷边上。雪地里散着大教堂和城墙的残骸，峡谷下面是界河。中午回卡尔斯，看卡尔斯博物馆，下午是卡尼塔比亚博物馆，讲 1877 年的俄土战争。
days.be: The morning at Ani, the medieval Armenian capital, on the gorge that is now the border with Armenia. Cathedrals and walls lie broken in the snow, the border river far below. Back to Kars at noon for the Kars Museum, and in the afternoon the Kanlı Tabya museum on the Russo-Turkish war of 1877.

days.bz: 上午在埃尔祖鲁姆，城堡上看得到整座城和远处的雪山，然后在城里的博物馆看奥斯曼时代的兵器和书法。下午往西到埃尔津詹，博物馆里讲阿尔廷泰佩的乌拉尔图遗址。晚上开到锡瓦斯。
days.be: Erzurum in the morning: the whole city and the snowy mountains from the castle, then Ottoman arms and calligraphy in the museums in town. West to Erzincan in the afternoon, whose museum covers the Urartian site of Altıntepe. On to Sivas at night.

days.zh: 锡瓦斯、托卡特、阿马西亚
days.bz: 上午在锡瓦斯，城市博物馆和塞尔柱时代的双尖塔神学院。中午到托卡特，博物馆设在一座老市场里，穹顶下悬着一组金色的圆环。下午到阿马西亚，河边山崖上凿着本都国王的岩墓。晚上开到黑海边的萨姆松。
days.be: Sivas in the morning, for the city museum and the Seljuk Çifte Minareli Madrasa. Tokat at noon, its museum in an old market hall, a set of golden rings hung under the dome. Amasya in the afternoon, the tombs of the Pontic kings cut into the cliff above the river. On to Samsun on the Black Sea at night.

days.bz: 上午在萨姆松，海边山坡上的草地，海岸公园里的纪念碑。然后沿着黑海往东开，路过奥尔杜，傍晚到吉雷松，城堡山上看得到海湾，博物馆设在一座老希腊教堂里。晚上住特拉布宗。
days.be: Samsun in the morning, the grass on the hill above the sea and the monument in the seafront park. Then east along the Black Sea, through Ordu, reaching Giresun at dusk: the bay from the castle hill, and a museum in an old Greek church. Overnight in Trabzon.

days.bz: 上午上山去苏美拉修道院，修道院嵌在悬崖的半腰上，岩洞教堂内外都是壁画。老照片里能看到 1905 年它还有人住的样子。下午回到特拉布宗，看圣索菲亚教堂。
days.be: Up the valley to Sumela Monastery in the morning, set halfway up a cliff, its rock church painted inside and out; old photographs show it still inhabited in 1905. Back in Trabzon in the afternoon, for the church of Hagia Sophia.

days.bz: 早上七点在特拉布宗机场还车，从特拉布宗离开。
days.be: Return the car at the Trabzon airport at 7 a.m. and fly out.

lede.zh: 东京、富山、金泽、山形、山寺、札幌、小樽、大沼、镰仓、仙台、长野、松本、京都、奈良、大阪、宫岛、广岛、下关、别府。
lede.en: Tokyo, Toyama, Kanazawa, Yamagata, Yamadera, Sapporo, Otaru, Ōnuma, Kamakura, Sendai, Nagano, Matsumoto, Kyoto, Nara, Osaka, Miyajima, Hiroshima, Shimonoseki, Beppu.

days.bz: 下午从 SFO 起飞，飞往成田。
days.be: Afternoon flight out of SFO, bound for Narita.

days.bz: 晚上落地成田，赶在九点前取 pocket wifi，入住上野。
days.be: Land at Narita in the evening, pick up the pocket wifi before 9, check in at Ueno.

days.bz: 只是冬已现。早上九点先到南千住，真正寺和円通寺门口的银杏正黄，院子里立着一排彰义队的追吊碑。然后去上野公园，看西乡隆盛像和彰义队之墓。十点前挤进国立西洋美术馆的莫奈展「睡莲之时」，《睡莲》前人挤人；出来时在前庭看了罗丹的《地狱之门》和《加莱义民》。
days.be: And yet winter is already here. Just after nine, Minami-Senju: the ginkgo at the gates of Shinshō-ji and Entsū-ji in full yellow, and a row of memorial stones to the Shōgitai in the yard. Then Ueno Park, for the statue of Saigō Takamori and the Shōgitai grave. Before ten, into the packed Monet water-lily show at the National Museum of Western Art, and on the way out Rodin's Gates of Hell and Burghers of Calais in the forecourt.

days.bz: JR Pass 从这天开始。上午在代官山和中目黑一带散步，路过一栋木格子外墙的新楼，沿着目黑川走了一段，两岸的樱花树叶子已经快落光了。下午坐新干线去北陆，傍晚到富山，站前的路面电车正好进站。
days.be: The rail pass begins today. A morning walk around Daikanyama and Naka-Meguro, past a new building wrapped in timber lattice and along the Meguro River, its cherry trees nearly bare. The Shinkansen to Hokuriku in the afternoon, reaching Toyama at dusk as a tram pulled in outside the station.

days.bz: 上午在富山的 TOYAMA キラリ，一栋木格子搭起来的楼，上层是富山市玻璃美术馆，下层是市立图书馆。看了一圈玻璃器和 Chihuly 的玻璃装置，又在书架间翻了会儿书。中午坐车到金泽，走过东茶屋街，吃了一支裹满金箔的冰淇淋。下午从石川门进兼六园，天阴着，枫叶还红着，池边的松树都拉着雪吊。傍晚上车，一路往东北，住山形。
days.be: Morning at TOYAMA Kirari in Toyama, a building of timber lattice with the Toyama Glass Art Museum upstairs and the city library below: a round of glasswork and the Chihuly installation, then some time among the bookshelves. At noon, the train to Kanazawa, a walk through the Higashi Chaya district and an ice cream wrapped in gold leaf. In the afternoon, in through the Ishikawa Gate to Kenroku-en, under a grey sky, the maples still red and the pines by the pond already roped against the snow. An evening train north-east, overnight in Yamagata.

days.bz: 上午在山形的霞城公园，沿着山形城址的护城河走了一圈。然后坐仙山线到山寺，登一千多级石阶上立石寺，山门口立着「奥の細道」的石碑，芭蕉在这里写过「閑かさや岩にしみ入る蝉の声」。正午到五大堂，云很低，整条山谷、村子和红叶都在脚下。下午坐车一路北上，晚上到札幌。
days.be: Morning at Kajō Park in Yamagata, a loop along the moat of the old castle. Then the Senzan Line to Yamadera and the thousand-odd stone steps up to Risshaku-ji, past the stone marking Bashō's Narrow Road to the Deep North; he wrote his haiku about the cicadas soaking into the rock here. At noon, the Godaidō hall, with low cloud and the whole valley, its village and its autumn colour below. Trains north all afternoon, reaching Sapporo at night.

days.bz: 从札幌去小樽一日。
days.be: A day trip from Sapporo to Otaru.

days.bz: 雪下得很大，干脆哪儿也不去，就在札幌待着，窗外一整天都在下雪。下午顶着雪出门，到南六条的拉面信玄，排了一会儿队，吃了一碗热拉面。
days.be: The snow came down hard, so I stayed put in Sapporo and watched it fall all day. In the afternoon I went out into it, to Ramen Shingen in Minami 6-jō, queued for a while, and had a hot bowl of ramen.

days.bz: 早上从札幌出发往南，窗外一路是雪原和海。中午到大沼国定公园，前一晚落了新雪，树枝上积着白，湖面灰蓝，远处的山也白了。晚上回到东京，住羽田。
days.be: South from Sapporo in the morning, past snowfields and sea. At noon, Ōnuma Quasi-National Park, under a fresh fall of snow: white branches, a grey-blue lake, the hills beyond gone white too. Back in Tokyo at night, sleeping at Haneda.

days.bz: 早上在上野公园，银杏正黄。上午登上晴空塔，隅田川和整片东京平原都在脚下。下午到新宿，在纪伊国屋书店逛了一圈，刘慈欣《三体》的日文版摆了一整排。傍晚进新宿御苑，大银杏树下的草地上全是人。
days.be: Ueno Park in the morning, the ginkgo at their yellowest. Up the Tokyo Skytree before noon, the Sumida River and the whole Kantō plain below. Shinjuku in the afternoon, a browse around Kinokuniya, where Liu Cixin's Three-Body books filled a whole row in Japanese. Shinjuku Gyoen at dusk, its lawn under the great ginkgo crowded with people.

days.bz: 上午在东京，中午去公司的东京办公室吃饭。下午到横须贺，登上停在三笠公园里的战舰三笠号：甲板上用铜牌标着东乡平八郎当年站立的位置，舰内展着日俄战争的形势图、伏见宫博恭王的介绍和《联合舰队解散之辞》。晚上住镰仓。
days.be: Tokyo in the morning, and lunch at my company's Tokyo office. In the afternoon, Yokosuka and the battleship Mikasa, berthed in Mikasa Park: a brass plate on the deck marks where Admiral Tōgō stood, and inside are maps of the Russo-Japanese War, a panel on Prince Fushimi Hiroyasu and the Combined Fleet's farewell address. Overnight in Kamakura.

days.bz: 看，迅哥儿！早上在镰仓，从由比滨走到鹤冈八幡宫，天蓝得透亮。然后一路北上仙台。下午在仙台市博物馆看伊达政宗和仙台藩的历史，出门就是鲁迅的胸像，他当年在仙台医专念过书；旁边还立着一块「日中不再战」的碑。傍晚上青叶山的仙台城址俯瞰全城，晚饭吃了牛舌。
days.be: Look, it's Lu Xun! Morning in Kamakura, walking from Yuigahama to Tsurugaoka Hachimangū under a perfectly clear sky. Then north to Sendai. In the afternoon, the Sendai City Museum and the story of Date Masamune and his domain; right outside is a bust of Lu Xun, who studied medicine in Sendai, and beside it a stone vowing that Japan and China will never fight again. At dusk, the castle ruins on Aobayama looking over the city, and beef tongue for dinner.

days.bz: 善光寺，川中岛古战场。
days.be: Zenko-ji and the Kawanakajima battlefield.

days.bz: 早上坐篠之井线往南，过姨舍站时，车窗外是整片善光寺平。中午在松本城，国宝天守是黑漆的五层楼，护城河边排着一列家纹灯笼；天守里展着各藩的火绳枪和合战图屏风，顶层能看到整座城下町和远处的山。下午沿中央线一路往东，傍晚车窗外还是连绵的山。
days.be: South on the Shinonoi Line in the morning, the whole Zenkōji plain below the window at Obasute. Matsumoto Castle at noon: the black-lacquered five-storey keep, a National Treasure, with lanterns bearing family crests along the moat; inside, matchlocks from different domains and a folding screen of a battle, and from the top floor the whole castle town and the mountains beyond. East along the Chūō Line all afternoon, still mountains outside the window at dusk.

days.bz: 清水寺、八坂神社、高台寺、建仁寺、六波罗蜜寺。
days.be: Kiyomizu-dera, Yasaka Shrine, Kodai-ji, Kennin-ji, Rokuharamitsu-ji.

days.bz: 上午从八濑坐缆车上比叡山，山顶能望见琵琶湖。在延历寺根本中堂一带转了一个多小时，再坐缆车下山。下午在八濑的琉璃光院，书院里的漆桌倒映着满窗的红叶，人挤得满满的。然后沿着哲学之道往南，经过银阁寺，到真如堂，最后是黑谷的金戒光明寺，山坡上是会津藩士的墓地。晚上朋友圈发了一段红叶里石佛的视频，那是荣摄院。
days.be: Up Mount Hiei by cable car from Yase in the morning, with Lake Biwa visible from the top, and an hour or more around the Konponchūdō of Enryaku-ji before riding back down. In the afternoon, Rurikō-in at Yase, where the lacquered desks reflect a whole window of red maples, and the room is packed. Then south along the Philosopher's Path, past Ginkaku-ji, to Shinnyo-dō, and last of all Konkai Kōmyō-ji at Kurodani, with the graves of the Aizu samurai on the hillside. That night's post was a short video of a stone Buddha among the maples, at Eishō-in.

days.bz: Yae & Joe。上午到南禅寺，先看金地院，再过三门，去看水路阁，明治年间修的红砖水道桥，至今还引着琵琶湖的水。经过永观堂，往若王子的山上走，是同志社的公共墓地：同志社大学的创办人新岛襄和他的妻子新岛八重葬在这里，旁边是八重的哥哥山本觉马，还有几位早年日本基督徒的墓，一座十字架立在红叶中。下午去东寺，阴天里的五重塔显得格外高。
days.be: Yae & Joe. Morning at Nanzen-ji: Konchi-in first, then through the great Sanmon gate to the Suirokaku, the brick aqueduct built in the Meiji era that still carries water from Lake Biwa. Past Eikandō and up the hill at Nyakuōji to the Dōshisha cemetery, where Niijima Jō, who founded Dōshisha University, lies with his wife Niijima Yae, beside her brother Yamamoto Kakuma and a few of Japan's early Christians, a stone cross standing among the maples. In the afternoon, Tō-ji, its five-storey pagoda looking taller than ever under a grey sky.

days.bz: 法金刚院、天龙寺、岚山、祇王寺。住在岚山。
days.be: Hokongo-in, Tenryu-ji, Arashiyama, Gio-ji. Overnight in Arashiyama.

days.bz: 宇治平等院，奈良唐招提寺，晚上到道顿堀。
days.be: Byodo-in at Uji, Toshodai-ji in Nara, Dotonbori at night.

days.bz: 大阪城和中之岛公园，路过神户，晚上住到严岛上。
days.be: Osaka Castle and Nakanoshima Park, through Kobe, and a night on Miyajima.

days.bz: 清晨在严岛，海边立着「日本三景碑」。上午坐船到吴，看大和博物馆：从明治年间引进造舰技术，到战时的市民生活，再到1950年旧军港市转换法公布。中午去江田岛，海上自卫队干部候补生学校里有一间扫雷部队的展室。下午回到广岛，在和平纪念公园的动员学徒慰灵塔前站了一会儿。
days.be: Early morning on Miyajima, the 'Three Views of Japan' stone by the shore. By boat to Kure before noon, for the Yamato Museum: from the Meiji-era import of shipbuilding know-how, through civilian life in wartime, to the 1950 law converting the old naval ports. Etajima at midday, where the Maritime Self-Defense Force officer candidate school has a room on the minesweeping units. Back to Hiroshima in the afternoon, and a while in front of the Memorial Tower to the Mobilized Students in the Peace Memorial Park.

days.bz: 下关的赤间神宫、坛之浦古战场、马关条约签订处，过海到门司港，住小仓。
days.be: Akama Shrine, the Dan-no-ura battlefield and the site of the Treaty of Shimonoseki, across the strait to Mojiko, overnight in Kokura.

days.bz: 别府温泉，整趟旅行最南的一站。
days.be: The hot springs of Beppu, the farthest south the trip goes.

days.bz: 返回东京，住羽田机场。
days.be: Back to Tokyo, a night at Haneda.

days.bz: 退还 pocket wifi，下午从羽田起飞，飞往伊斯坦布尔。
days.be: Return the pocket wifi, and fly out of Haneda for Istanbul in the afternoon.

lede.zh: 温哥华、多伦多、哈德逊河谷、纽约、芝加哥；奥斯汀、休斯顿、卡纳维拉尔角、奥兰多、劳德代尔堡、亚特兰大。
lede.en: Vancouver, Toronto, the Hudson Valley, New York, Chicago; Austin, Houston, Cape Canaveral, Orlando, Fort Lauderdale, Atlanta.

1.zh: 温哥华、多伦多、纽约、芝加哥

2.zh: 德州、佛罗里达、亚特兰大

days.bz: 阴天的温哥华。中午在煤气镇，老街口的蒸汽钟正好放气报时。走到加拿大广场，码头上停着一艘大邮轮，对岸的北岸群山压在云里。下午沿海边走到英吉利湾，在沙滩上吃了一支冰淇淋，看了海边的因纽特石人。第二天中午从温哥华飞多伦多，半夜才到，CN 塔亮着蓝灯。
days.be: Vancouver under cloud. Gastown at noon, just as the steam clock on the old corner let off its whistle. On to Canada Place, a big cruise ship at the pier and the North Shore mountains buried in cloud across the water. In the afternoon, along the shore to English Bay, an ice cream on the beach and the inukshuk by the water. A flight to Toronto the next day, landing after midnight with the CN Tower lit up blue.

days.bz: 下午先去卡萨罗马，二十世纪初一位金融家盖的城堡，书房、管风琴一间间看过去；顶楼是女王直属来复枪团的团史博物馆，讲到了芬尼亚人袭击和两次世界大战。然后去多伦多大学，走了哲学家小径，进了托马斯·费舍尔善本图书馆，一层层书架围着中庭。之后两天都在城里，傍晚的 CN 塔就在街口。
days.be: Casa Loma first, a castle built by a financier in the early twentieth century, room after room of studies and an organ; the top floor holds the regimental museum of the Queen's Own Rifles, from the Fenian Raids to the two world wars. Then the University of Toronto: Philosopher's Walk, and the Thomas Fisher Rare Book Library, its stacks rising storey by storey around the atrium. Two more days in the city, the CN Tower at the end of the street in the evening.

days.bz: 一早离开多伦多，上午到了纽约，从乔治·华盛顿大桥那一头下来，在新泽西吃了午饭，然后往北开进哈德逊河谷。在乡间住了三晚，院子外就是草地和树林，清晨和傍晚都有鹿出来吃草。屋里一整面墙的书，还有一排《大藏经》。
days.be: Out of Toronto early and into New York by late morning, down off the George Washington Bridge for lunch in New Jersey, then north into the Hudson Valley. Three nights in the countryside, meadow and woods right outside, deer grazing every morning and evening. Indoors, a whole wall of books, including a row of the Buddhist canon.

days.bz: 回到曼哈顿，住在西边。哈德逊河边看得到对岸的泽西城，天气好的时候远处是自由女神像。周四下午去美国自然历史博物馆，在墨西哥和中美洲展厅看奥尔梅克巨石头像、阿兹特克太阳石和秘鲁的陶俑；傍晚从高楼上看帝国大厦，晚上在纪伊国屋书店的日文书架前待了很久。离开前在新泽西吃了一顿火锅。
days.be: Back in Manhattan, on the West Side. Jersey City across the Hudson, and on clear days the Statue of Liberty far off. On Thursday afternoon, the American Museum of Natural History: an Olmec colossal head, the Aztec Sun Stone and Peruvian ceramic figures in the Mexico and Central America hall. The Empire State Building from high up at dusk, and a long time at the Japanese shelves in Kinokuniya that night. A hotpot dinner in New Jersey before leaving.

days.bz: 中午落地奥黑尔。下午在芝加哥艺术博物馆，从日本陶器、中国的陶狗到埃尔·格列柯。第二天上威利斯大厦，一边是密歇根湖，一边是一直铺到天边的城区；下午沿芝加哥河看两岸的高楼，经过论坛报大楼。最后一天去了菲尔德自然史博物馆和谢德水族馆，傍晚走到唐人街，看了九龙壁。
days.be: Landing at O'Hare at noon. The Art Institute of Chicago in the afternoon, from Japanese ceramics and a Chinese pottery dog to El Greco. Up Willis Tower the next day, Lake Michigan on one side and the city running to the horizon on the other; in the afternoon, along the Chicago River past the towers and Tribune Tower. On the last day, the Field Museum and the Shedd Aquarium, then Chinatown at dusk and its Nine Dragon Wall.

days.bz: 国庆节到奥斯汀，下午在公司的办公室，从高处看得到整个城区和远处的新楼。晚上一大箱西瓜。
days.be: Arriving in Austin on the Fourth of July. An afternoon at my company's office, the whole city and its new towers visible from high up. A crate of watermelons in the evening.

days.zh: 休斯顿的约翰逊航天中心
days.bz: 冒着暴雨开到休斯顿。下午在约翰逊航天中心：展厅里是阿波罗时代的发动机和登月着陆点的地图；坐园区小火车出去，看小乔火箭、一整枚横躺在库房里的土星五号，还有驮着航天飞机的波音 747。晚上吃了烤串。
days.be: Driving to Houston through a downpour. Johnson Space Center in the afternoon: Apollo-era engines and a map of the lunar landing sites inside, then the tram out to a Little Joe rocket, a whole Saturn V lying in its hangar, and the Boeing 747 with a space shuttle on its back. Kebabs for dinner.

days.bz: 回到奥斯汀。傍晚去德州议会大厦，门前是牛仔赶牛的群像；圆厅的地面上嵌着德州先后归属过的六面旗帜，抬头是比国会大厦还高的穹顶。草坪上有非裔美国人历史纪念碑，出门往南走到圣母玛利亚主教座堂。
days.be: Back in Austin. The Texas Capitol in the evening, a cattle-drive monument by the door; the rotunda floor bears the six flags Texas has flown under, and overhead a dome taller than the one in Washington. The Texas African American History Memorial on the grounds, and a walk south to St. Mary Cathedral.

days.bz: 飞到奥兰多，开车往东到卡纳维拉尔角。肯尼迪航天中心的火箭花园里立着一排早期火箭；坐巴士进园区，远处是飞行器总装大楼和发射台。阿波罗/土星五号中心里，阿波罗时代的发射控制室按原样保留，一整枚土星五号从头顶横过，下面挂满了每次任务的徽章。
days.be: A flight to Orlando and a drive east to Cape Canaveral. At Kennedy Space Center, early rockets stand in a row in the Rocket Garden; a bus into the grounds, with the Vehicle Assembly Building and the launch pads in the distance. In the Apollo/Saturn V Center the firing room is kept as it was, and a whole Saturn V hangs overhead above the patches of every mission.

days.bz: 在奥兰多环球影城玩了一天，入口是一座钟楼，园区里到处是棕榈树和卡通人物，天热得发烫。
days.be: A day at Universal Orlando: a clock tower at the gate, palms and cartoon characters everywhere, and heat you could feel through your shoes.

days.bz: 往南开到劳德代尔堡一带，住在朋友家，家里有一只很亲人的橘猫。第二天下午在泳池边待着，傍晚走到湖边的湿地，看到好几只鳄鱼浮在水面上，只露出眼睛和鼻子。
days.be: South to the Fort Lauderdale area, staying with a friend and their very friendly ginger cat. By the pool the next afternoon, then at dusk down to the wetland by the lake, where several alligators floated with only their eyes and noses above the water.

days.bz: 最后一站亚特兰大，从高处看得到整片城区和树林。第二天晚上吃了顿泰国菜，然后回家。
days.be: Last stop, Atlanta, the city and its trees spread out below. Thai food the next evening, then home.

title.zh: 从北欧到巴尔干，2023 年冬
title.en: From the Nordics to the Balkans, winter 2023

lede.zh: 奥斯陆、哥德堡、斯德哥尔摩、赫尔辛基、塔林、里加、格但斯克、马尔堡、哥本哈根；维也纳、布拉迪斯拉发、布达佩斯、卢布尔雅那、的里雅斯特、萨格勒布、里耶卡、扎达尔、斯普利特、杜布罗夫尼克、科托尔、地拉那、斯科普里、尼什、贝尔格莱德、诺维萨德、萨拉热窝。
lede.en: Oslo, Gothenburg, Stockholm, Helsinki, Tallinn, Riga, Gdańsk, Malbork, Copenhagen; Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest, Ljubljana, Trieste, Zagreb, Rijeka, Zadar, Split, Dubrovnik, Kotor, Tirana, Skopje, Niš, Belgrade, Novi Sad, Sarajevo.

days.bz: 早上从旧金山起飞，只背了一个包。夜里飞过格陵兰上空，窗外出现了极光，绿色的光带在机翼下面晃了好一阵。
days.be: An early flight out of San Francisco with just a backpack. Crossing Greenland in the night, the aurora appeared outside the window, a green band wavering below the wing for a long while.

days.bz: 中午落地奥斯陆，窗外是雪地和峡湾。下午去蒙克美术馆，《呐喊》有好几个版本摆在一起。晚上在雨里走回住处。
days.be: Landing in Oslo at noon over snow and fjords. The Munch Museum in the afternoon, where several versions of The Scream hang side by side. A walk back through the rain at night.

days.bz: 上午在比格迪半岛的前进号博物馆，南森和阿蒙森的极地船就停在馆里，满墙是南极探险的地图和当年的报纸。之后去雪中的阿克斯胡斯城堡。傍晚坐大巴去哥德堡。
days.be: The Fram Museum on Bygdøy in the morning, Nansen's and Amundsen's polar ship inside, the walls covered with maps of the race to the Pole and the newspapers of the day. Then Akershus Fortress in the snow, and an evening bus to Gothenburg.

days.bz: 在哥德堡随便逛了逛，进了几家书店和漫画店，广场上立着圣诞树，集市正热闹。下午坐火车去斯德哥尔摩。
days.be: A wander around Gothenburg, into a few bookshops and a comics shop, a Christmas tree up on the square and the market in full swing. The train to Stockholm in the afternoon.

days.bz: 一整天在博物馆岛：北欧博物馆，然后是瓦萨号博物馆，1628 年首航就沉没的战舰几乎完整地立在馆里。傍晚去历史博物馆看中世纪的木雕祭坛。
days.be: A whole day on Djurgården: the Nordic Museum, then the Vasa Museum, where the warship that sank on her maiden voyage in 1628 stands almost whole. The History Museum's carved medieval altarpieces at dusk.

days.bz: 早上飞到赫尔辛基，城里积着雪。下午在自然史博物馆，傍晚路过亮着灯的颂歌图书馆，最后到议会广场上的圣诞集市。
days.be: An early flight to Helsinki, snow lying in the city. The Natural History Museum in the afternoon, then past Oodi library lit up at dusk, and on to the Christmas market on Senate Square.

days.bz: 一早坐渡轮过芬兰湾到塔林。老城里爬上城墙，看了「厨房窥视」炮塔和城墙里的博物馆。
days.be: The morning ferry across the Gulf of Finland to Tallinn. Up onto the old town walls, the Kiek in de Kök tower and the museum inside the walls.

days.bz: 清晨坐大巴去里加。下午在里加历史博物馆，然后是市政厅广场上的黑头宫，大厅和地下的展厅都看了。
days.be: An early bus to Riga. The Museum of the History of Riga in the afternoon, then the House of the Blackheads on Town Hall Square, its great hall and its cellars.

days.bz: 上午登上里加圣彼得教堂的塔顶，老城的雪屋顶和道加瓦河都在脚下。中午飞格但斯克，在机场取了车。平安夜的长街灯火通明。
days.be: St. Peter's tower in Riga in the morning, the snowy roofs of the old town and the Daugava below. A noon flight to Gdańsk and a rental car at the airport. Christmas Eve on the Long Market, all lit up.

days.bz: 圣诞节，海边几乎没人。上午在格但斯克附近的海边走了一段，沙滩空荡荡的。下午开车往东，傍晚到埃尔布隆格。
days.be: Christmas Day, the seaside almost deserted. A morning walk along the Baltic near Gdańsk, the beach empty. East by car in the afternoon, reaching Elbląg at dusk.

days.bz: 开车到马尔堡，条顿骑士团的总部，世界上最大的砖砌城堡。城墙上爬满了藤，礼拜堂里的祭坛金光闪闪，院子里立着历代大团长的雕像。
days.be: A drive to Malbork, seat of the Teutonic Order and the largest brick castle in the world: ivy up the walls, a glittering altarpiece in the chapel, the grand masters in stone in the courtyard.

days.zh: 格但斯克的两座博物馆
days.bz: 上午在二战博物馆，二战的第一枪就在格但斯克的西盘半岛打响。下午去欧洲团结工会中心，看团结工会从造船厂罢工到改变东欧的经过。晚上飞哥本哈根。
days.be: The Museum of the Second World War in the morning; the war's first shots were fired at Westerplatte in Gdańsk. The European Solidarity Centre in the afternoon, on how a shipyard strike grew into the movement that changed Eastern Europe. An evening flight to Copenhagen.

days.bz: 在哥本哈根城里闲逛。登上圆塔，沿着螺旋坡道走到顶，看城市的屋顶。下午在国家博物馆，从埃及木乃伊到镀金祭坛，最后在一面墙的漫画前停了很久。
days.be: A wander around Copenhagen. Up the spiral ramp of the Round Tower to the rooftops. The National Museum in the afternoon, from Egyptian mummies to gilded altars, and a long stop in front of a wall of comics.

days.zh: 管风琴教堂和小美人鱼
days.en: Grundtvig's Church and the Little Mermaid
days.bz: 上午去管风琴教堂，黄砖砌出的中殿高得像一排管风琴。下午沿着城堡公园的土坡走到小美人鱼，岸边挤满了人，最后到新港。
days.be: Grundtvig's Church in the morning, its yellow-brick nave rising like a row of organ pipes. In the afternoon along the ramparts of Kastellet to the Little Mermaid, crowded as ever, and on to Nyhavn.

days.bz: 离开哥本哈根，飞过中欧的平原降落在布达佩斯，再往西去维也纳。
days.be: Out of Copenhagen, across the plains of Central Europe to Budapest, and west again to Vienna.

days.bz: 上午在美景宫。下午去霍夫堡的皇家珍宝馆，然后是艺术史博物馆，看卡拉瓦乔和鲁本斯。除夕夜的维也纳到处是人。
days.be: The Belvedere in the morning. The Imperial Treasury in the Hofburg in the afternoon, then the Kunsthistorisches Museum for Caravaggio and Rubens. Vienna crowded on New Year's Eve.

days.bz: 新年第一天。上午在圣斯德望主教座堂和黑死病纪念柱，然后走到霍夫堡，中午在宫里听了一场新年音乐会。
days.be: New Year's Day. St. Stephen's Cathedral and the Plague Column in the morning, then on to the Hofburg for a New Year concert at midday.

days.zh: 布拉迪斯拉发和塞克什白堡
days.bz: 早上坐车到布拉迪斯拉发，在老城和多瑙河边走了走。下午转车去匈牙利的塞克什白堡，晚上老城亮着灯。
days.be: A morning ride to Bratislava, a walk through the old town and along the Danube. Onward to Székesfehérvár in Hungary in the afternoon, the old town lit up at night.

days.zh: 加冕之城，然后布达佩斯
days.bz: 塞克什白堡是匈牙利中世纪的加冕之城，上午看了加冕教堂的遗址。下午到布达佩斯，登上城堡山，多瑙河和链子桥都在脚下，然后去国家美术馆。
days.be: Székesfehérvár was where medieval Hungary crowned its kings; the ruins of the coronation basilica in the morning. Budapest in the afternoon, up Castle Hill above the Danube and the Chain Bridge, then the National Gallery.

days.bz: 上午在匈牙利国家博物馆，从路易大帝讲到拉科齐家族。傍晚进圣伊什特万大教堂，晚上在多瑙河边看亮灯的国会大厦。
days.be: The Hungarian National Museum in the morning, from Louis the Great to the Rákóczis. St. Stephen's Basilica at dusk, and Parliament lit up on the Danube at night.

days.bz: 早上从布达佩斯坐大巴，下午到卢布尔雅那。看了一个小博物馆，傍晚走到普雷舍伦广场，圣诞树还没撤，龙桥上的龙亮着灯。
days.be: A morning bus from Budapest, reaching Ljubljana in the afternoon. A small museum, then Prešeren Square at dusk, the Christmas tree still up and the Dragon Bridge lit.

days.bz: 早上坐大巴到意大利的的里雅斯特。老城里找到了乔伊斯住过的地方，进了塞尔维亚东正教的圣斯皮里东教堂，又看了罗马剧场和里卡多拱门。
days.be: An early bus to Trieste in Italy. In the old town, a plaque where James Joyce lived, the Serbian Orthodox church of San Spiridione, the Roman theatre and the Arco di Riccardo.

days.bz: 早上从的里雅斯特坐大巴到萨格勒布。傍晚去了失恋博物馆，每件展品旁边都附着一段捐赠者写下的故事。晚上的耶拉契奇广场。
days.be: The morning bus from Trieste to Zagreb. The Museum of Broken Relationships in the evening, each object with its donor's story beside it. Ban Jelačić Square at night.

days.bz: 早上的大巴穿过下着雪的山区，中午到海边的里耶卡。下午去城市博物馆，然后爬上特尔萨特城堡，山下是港口和峡谷上的桥。
days.be: The morning bus through snowy hills, reaching Rijeka on the coast at noon. The city museum in the afternoon, then up to Trsat Castle, the port and the bridge over the gorge below.

days.bz: 大巴沿着海岸往南开到扎达尔。下午在海边，听海风琴：海浪从台阶下涌进管子里，发出呜呜的声音。旁边是「向太阳致敬」。
days.be: South along the coast by bus to Zadar. An afternoon by the sea listening to the Sea Organ, the waves pushing into pipes beneath the steps and making them hum, beside the Greeting to the Sun.

days.bz: 中午到斯普利特。下午在戴克里先宫，罗马皇帝的宫殿至今仍是城里人住的老城，地下室几乎完整地保存着。傍晚沿着棕榈树下的海滨大道走。
days.be: Split by midday. Diocletian's Palace in the afternoon, a Roman emperor's palace that is still the lived-in old town, its substructures almost intact. A walk along the palm-lined Riva at dusk.

days.bz: 上午到杜布罗夫尼克，先去城外的洛夫里耶纳茨要塞，再绕着城墙走了一圈，一边是红屋顶，一边是海。城墙上有猫晒太阳。
days.be: Dubrovnik by late morning: Fort Lovrijenac outside the walls first, then the full circuit of the walls, red roofs on one side and the sea on the other, and a cat asleep in the sun.

days.bz: 中午坐大巴到黑山的科托尔。下午沿着山坡上的台阶爬到圣约翰要塞，整个科托尔湾都在脚下，夕阳把山照成了金色。
days.be: A midday bus to Kotor in Montenegro. In the afternoon, up the steps on the hillside to the fortress of St. John, the whole Bay of Kotor below and the mountains turning gold at sunset.

days.bz: 早上从科托尔坐大巴，沿着斯库台湖进入阿尔巴尼亚，湖边一片芦苇。傍晚到地拉那。
days.be: A morning bus out of Kotor, along Lake Skadar into Albania, reeds all along the shore. Tirana by evening.

days.bz: 上午在斯坎德培广场。然后去看讲述霍查时代的展览：对宗教的打压、恩维尔·霍查之死、政权的敌人。晚上坐大巴去北马其顿的斯科普里。
days.be: Skanderbeg Square in the morning, then an exhibition on the Hoxha years: the campaign against religion, the death of Enver Hoxha, the regime's enemies. A night bus to Skopje in North Macedonia.

days.bz: 早上在斯科普里的瓦尔达尔河边走了一段，然后坐大巴进入塞尔维亚，边境上有一只小狗一直跟着。下午到尼什。
days.be: A morning walk along the Vardar in Skopje, then a bus into Serbia, a puppy following us at the border. Niš by the afternoon.

days.bz: 早上从尼什坐大巴到贝尔格莱德。下午在卡莱梅格丹要塞，要塞里的军事博物馆从巴尔干战争讲到萨拉热窝事件。
days.be: The morning bus from Niš to Belgrade. Kalemegdan Fortress in the afternoon, and the Military Museum inside it, from the Balkan Wars to the Sarajevo assassination.

days.bz: 在贝尔格莱德的南斯拉夫博物馆，看铁托的葬礼照片和各地送来的礼物，其中一面挂毯上绣着「铁托同志，我们向你宣誓」。
days.be: The Museum of Yugoslavia in Belgrade: photographs of Tito's funeral and gifts sent from all over, one tapestry stitched with 'Comrade Tito, we pledge to you'.

days.bz: 早上坐火车到诺维萨德。看了市政厅和伏伊伏丁那博物馆，下午过河上彼得罗瓦拉丁要塞，钟楼的指针是反着的。晚上坐夜车去萨拉热窝。
days.be: A morning train to Novi Sad. The City Hall and the Museum of Vojvodina, then across the river to Petrovaradin Fortress and its clock with hands the wrong way round. The night train to Sarajevo.

days.bz: 早上到萨拉热窝。在波黑历史博物馆，院子里停着围城时期的坦克和高射炮，展厅讲 1992 年到 1995 年的围城。下午在国家博物馆看罗马碑刻、老村庄模型和奥斯曼时代的居室。
days.be: Arriving in Sarajevo in the morning. The History Museum, with tanks and anti-aircraft guns from the siege in the yard and the siege of 1992 to 1995 inside. The National Museum in the afternoon: Roman inscriptions, a model village and an Ottoman-era room.

days.bz: 一夜大雪，整座山城都白了。上午看了市政厅，走进巴什察尔希亚老城，广场上全是鸽子，然后是加齐·胡斯雷夫-贝伊清真寺。下午看围城时期的地图和遗物。晚上坐夜车回贝尔格莱德。
days.be: A night of heavy snow turned the whole hillside city white. The City Hall in the morning, then into Baščaršija, its square full of pigeons, and the Gazi Husrev-beg Mosque. A map and objects from the siege in the afternoon, and the night bus back to Belgrade.

days.bz: 清晨到贝尔格莱德，老火车站和斯特凡·奈马尼亚纪念像还亮着灯。中午从贝尔格莱德起飞，一路飞过积雪的欧洲，回到旧金山。
days.be: Belgrade at dawn, the old railway station and the Stefan Nemanja monument still lit. A midday flight out of Belgrade, over snowy Europe, and home to San Francisco.

span.zh: 2023 年 6 月 13 日至 7 月 7 日

lede.zh: 东京、日光、会津若松、函馆、青森、十和田湖、上田、横滨、河口湖、京都、奈良、大阪、姬路、鹿儿岛、阿苏、长崎、太宰府、广岛、宫岛、镰仓、箱根。
lede.en: Tokyo, Nikkō, Aizu-Wakamatsu, Hakodate, Aomori, Lake Towada, Ueda, Yokohama, Lake Kawaguchi, Kyoto, Nara, Osaka, Himeji, Kagoshima, Aso, Nagasaki, Dazaifu, Hiroshima, Miyajima, Kamakura, Hakone.

days.bz: 晚上落地成田，领了 JR Pass 和西瓜卡，住在新宿。
days.be: Landing at Narita in the evening, picking up the rail pass and a Suica, and a night in Shinjuku.

days.bz: 清晨在新宿和歌舞伎町一带走，街上还没什么人。白天在住宅区里乱逛，下午到乃木神社。
days.be: An early walk through Shinjuku and Kabukichō before the crowds. A wander through residential streets, and Nogi Shrine in the afternoon.

days.bz: 上午在上野动物园，小熊猫、长颈鹿和一排排笼舍，出来就是上野公园。
days.be: The morning at Ueno Zoo, red pandas, giraffes and rows of enclosures, with Ueno Park right outside.

days.bz: 上午在华严瀑布和中禅寺湖，山谷里到处是瀑布。下午下山到日光东照宫、二荒山神社和轮王寺大猷院。
days.be: Kegon Falls and Lake Chūzenji in the morning, waterfalls all down the valley. In the afternoon, down to Nikkō Tōshō-gū, Futarasan Shrine and Taiyū-in.

days.bz: 一路坐车穿过山区，窗外是田和杉林。下午到会津若松，看了会津藩的藩校日新馆一带。
days.be: Trains through the mountains all morning, fields and cedars outside. Aizu-Wakamatsu in the afternoon, and the area around the domain school, the Nisshinkan.

days.zh: 会津若松，然后北上函馆
days.bz: 上午爬上饭盛山，看戊辰战争中白虎队少年的墓地。中午到鹤之城，城下的溪水很清。之后一路往北，晚上到函馆。
days.be: Up Iimoriyama in the morning, to the graves of the Byakkotai boys of the Boshin War. Tsuruga Castle at midday, a clear stream below its walls. Then north all the way to Hakodate by night.

days.bz: 上午登上五棱郭塔，看星形的要塞。下午去看土方岁三战死的地方，他是新选组的副长，最后死在这里。
days.be: Up Goryōkaku Tower in the morning, the star-shaped fortress below. In the afternoon, the place where Hijikata Toshizō, vice-commander of the Shinsengumi, fell.

days.bz: 早上离开函馆，回到本州的青森，车站里在办庵野秀明展。下午坐车进山，住在十和田的温泉酒店。
days.be: Out of Hakodate in the morning, back to Honshu at Aomori, where the station was showing a Hideaki Anno exhibition. Into the hills in the afternoon, to a hot-spring hotel at Towada.

days.bz: 一整天在奥入濑溪流和十和田湖。溪水在树林里一段段落成小瀑布，湖水清得发蓝。
days.be: A whole day on the Oirase stream and Lake Towada, the water falling step by step through the woods and the lake a clear blue.

days.en: Ueda Castle and the Railway Museum
days.bz: 中午在上田城，真田家的城，看了真田石和城里的博物馆。下午到大宫的铁道博物馆，一整个大厅的老机车。
days.be: Ueda Castle at noon, the Sanada family's castle, its great Sanada stone and the museum. The Railway Museum at Ōmiya in the afternoon, a whole hall of old locomotives.

days.bz: 下午在涩谷看了八公像。晚上去横滨听 YOASOBI 的演唱会，整个场馆都是激光。
days.be: Hachikō in Shibuya in the afternoon. In the evening, a YOASOBI concert in Yokohama, the whole arena full of lasers.

days.bz: 坐富士急去河口湖，傍晚到湖边，云压得很低。
days.be: The Fujikyū line to Lake Kawaguchi, reaching the shore at dusk under low cloud.

days.bz: 上午在河口浅间神社，田野里立着一座鸟居。下午回到横滨，红砖仓库、山下公园，傍晚到中华街。
days.be: Kawaguchi Asama Shrine in the morning, a torii standing in the fields. Back to Yokohama in the afternoon: the Red Brick Warehouse, Yamashita Park, and Chinatown at dusk.

days.bz: 上午在同志社大学的红砖校园，然后去东山。下午在京都铁道博物馆，蒸汽机车和一整片铁路模型。
days.be: The red-brick campus of Dōshisha in the morning, then Higashiyama. The Kyoto Railway Museum in the afternoon, steam locomotives and a whole landscape of model railway.

days.bz: 一整天在奈良公园，小鹿在树下睡觉，大鹿一直凑到镜头前。晚上到大阪的道顿堀。
days.be: A whole day in Nara Park, fawns asleep under the trees and bucks pushing right up to the lens. Dōtonbori in Osaka at night.

days.bz: 在日本环球影城玩了一天，人山人海。晚上去新世界。
days.be: A day at Universal Studios Japan, packed with people. Shinsekai in the evening.

days.bz: 上午在姬路城，天守上看得到整座城。然后坐新干线一路往南，傍晚到鹿儿岛，看了西乡隆盛的诞生地和西南战争留下的弹痕。
days.be: Himeji Castle in the morning, the whole city below the keep. Then south by Shinkansen to Kagoshima by evening, to Saigō Takamori's birthplace and the bullet marks left by the Satsuma Rebellion.

days.bz: 坐车到阿苏，一整天下雨起雾，在草山和溪谷之间转了转。
days.be: Out to Aso, rain and fog all day, and a wander among the grassy hills and ravines instead.

days.bz: 上午在长崎的哥拉巴园和传教士的遗迹，中午去和平公园。傍晚到太宰府天满宫，走过红色的太鼓桥。
days.be: Glover Garden and the traces of the missionaries in Nagasaki in the morning, the Peace Park at midday. Dazaifu Tenmangū at dusk, over its red arched bridge.

days.bz: 清晨在广岛，上午坐船到宫岛，海边的松树下都是鹿。中午回到广岛和平纪念公园，看了原爆之子像和慰灵碑。
days.be: Hiroshima at dawn, then the ferry to Miyajima, deer under the pines by the sea. Back to the Peace Memorial Park at noon, the Children's Peace Monument and the Cenotaph.

days.bz: 上午在镰仓的寺院和鹤冈八幡宫，中午走小町通，下午到长谷。傍晚上山住箱根。
days.be: Kamakura's temples and Tsurugaoka Hachimangū in the morning, Komachi-dōri at midday, Hase in the afternoon. Up into the hills to Hakone at dusk.

days.bz: 上午的大涌谷全在雾里，只闻得到硫磺味。下午到芦之湖边的箱根神社，然后是雕刻之森美术馆和「网之森」。
days.be: Ōwakudani lost in mist in the morning, only the smell of sulphur. Hakone Shrine by Lake Ashi in the afternoon, then the Open-Air Museum and its Woods of Net.

days.bz: 回到东京，下午在新宿的纪伊国屋书店逛了很久。
days.be: Back in Tokyo, and a long afternoon in Kinokuniya in Shinjuku.

days.bz: 白天买书，傍晚从有乐町走到银座，四丁目的和光钟楼亮着灯。
days.be: Books by day, then a walk from Yūrakuchō to Ginza at dusk, the Wakō clock tower lit at 4-chōme.

days.bz: 离开前一天在东京国立博物馆，碑拓、屏风和印染的布，表庆馆前是一池水。
days.be: A last day at the Tokyo National Museum: stele rubbings, painted screens and printed textiles, the Hyōkeikan beyond its pond.

lede.zh: 新奥尔良；优胜美地、湾区、旧金山、大苏尔、洛杉矶、圣地亚哥。
lede.en: New Orleans; Yosemite, the Bay Area, San Francisco, Big Sur, Los Angeles and San Diego.

days.bz: 在新奥尔良的法语区。街上跑着马车，路牌上还留着西班牙时代的「波旁街」瓷砖，河边就是密西西比河。下午进圣路易斯大教堂，傍晚在铁艺阳台下面逛。
days.be: The French Quarter of New Orleans: carriages in the streets, Spanish-era tiles still naming 'Calle Borbón', the Mississippi at the end of the street. St. Louis Cathedral in the afternoon, and a wander under the wrought-iron balconies at dusk.

days.en: The WWII Museum and the cemetery
days.bz: 下午在国家二战博物馆，大厅里吊着当年的飞机，展厅里把同盟国和轴心国的将领排成两面墙。傍晚去了圣路易斯墓园，一座座地上墓室排成街道。
days.be: The National WWII Museum in the afternoon, planes hung in the great hall and the Allied and Axis commanders arranged on facing walls. St. Louis Cemetery at dusk, its above-ground tombs laid out like streets.

days.bz: 在奥杜邦动物园逛了一天，火烈鸟、青蛙馆，还有树林里的猴子。
days.be: A day at Audubon Zoo: flamingos, the frog house, and monkeys in the trees.

days.bz: 上午在公园的湖边。下午坐船进沼泽，岸边的草里趴着一只鳄鱼，柏树林泡在水里，树上挂着松萝。
days.be: By a lake in the park in the morning. A boat into the swamp in the afternoon, an alligator in the grass on the bank, cypress woods standing in the water, hung with Spanish moss.

days.bz: 最后一天在河边的西班牙广场，喷泉四周的瓷砖拼着西班牙各省的纹章，其中一块是萨拉曼卡。
days.be: A last day at Spanish Plaza by the river, the fountain ringed with tiles bearing the arms of the Spanish provinces, Salamanca among them.

days.bz: 上午从隧道观景点看进优胜美地山谷，下到谷底看优胜美地瀑布。傍晚上冰川点，半穹顶就在对面。
days.be: Tunnel View in the morning, looking into Yosemite Valley, then down to the valley floor and Yosemite Falls. Glacier Point in the evening, Half Dome right across the way.

days.bz: 从山里开回湾区，下午在硅谷看了几家科技公司的园区。傍晚进旧金山，在唐人街吃饭，街口就是绿色的哥伦布大楼。
days.be: Back down to the Bay Area, and an afternoon visiting a few tech campuses in Silicon Valley. Into San Francisco at dusk, dinner in Chinatown, the green Columbus Tower on the corner.

days.bz: 上午走上金门大桥。然后去十六街的马赛克台阶，台阶顶上看得到整个旧金山的日落区和太平洋。
days.be: Onto the Golden Gate Bridge in the morning. Then the 16th Avenue tiled steps, with the Sunset District and the Pacific spread out from the top.

days.bz: 沿着一号公路往南，经过卡梅尔的小镇，下午到大苏尔，比克斯比溪桥架在海边的峡谷上。
days.be: South along Highway 1, through the little town of Carmel, to Big Sur in the afternoon, Bixby Creek Bridge spanning its canyon above the sea.

days.bz: 在洛杉矶的好莱坞大道，看了一家电影博物馆，在星光大道上找熟悉的名字。晚上上格里菲斯天文台看洛杉矶的夜景。
days.be: Hollywood Boulevard in Los Angeles, a film museum, and familiar names on the Walk of Fame. Griffith Observatory at night, the city lights spread out below.

days.bz: 在圣地亚哥的海洋世界，白鲸、海豹、企鹅和海狮。傍晚到老城历史公园。
days.be: SeaWorld San Diego: belugas, seals, penguins and sea lions. Old Town State Historic Park in the evening.

title.zh: 西班牙、法国、意大利，2017 年夏

lede.zh: 从马德里出发，走过卡斯蒂利亚和安达卢西亚，到巴塞罗那；再经波尔多、巴黎、斯特拉斯堡、日内瓦、里昂，翻过阿尔卑斯，从都灵一路南下到庞贝。
lede.en: From Madrid through Castile and Andalusia to Barcelona; then Bordeaux, Paris, Strasbourg, Geneva and Lyon, over the Alps, and down Italy from Turin to Pompeii.

days.bz: 落地马德里。从议会大厦走到太阳门，广场上立着「Tío Pepe」的老霓虹招牌；再穿过红墙的马约尔广场，傍晚到阿尔穆德纳大教堂和对面的王宫。
days.be: Landing in Madrid. From the Congress of Deputies to Puerta del Sol and its old Tío Pepe sign, through the red walls of the Plaza Mayor, and to Almudena Cathedral and the Royal Palace facing it at dusk.

days.bz: 一早在萨拉曼卡，金黄色的砂岩城。看了耶稣会学院、萨拉曼卡大学雕满花纹的正门，墙上还留着学生用红色颜料写的「Vítor」。然后是新旧两座大教堂。
days.be: An early start in Salamanca, a city of golden sandstone: the Clerecía, the carved main door of the University, and the red 'Vítor' marks students painted on the walls. Then the old and new cathedrals.

days.zh: 塞哥维亚和埃斯科里亚尔
days.bz: 上午在塞哥维亚，罗马水道桥从城里一直跨到城外；城里还有哥特式的大教堂，城墙外是一片卡斯蒂利亚的田野。下午到埃斯科里亚尔修道院。
days.be: Segovia in the morning, the Roman aqueduct striding across town, the Gothic cathedral inside the walls and the Castilian fields beyond them. The monastery of El Escorial in the afternoon.

days.bz: 上午在托莱多，塔霍河绕着山城转了一圈，从阿尔坎塔拉桥头的城门进城。下午回到马德里，去了皇家马德里的伯纳乌球场。
days.be: Toledo in the morning, the Tagus looping round the hill town, in through the gate by the Alcántara bridge. Back to Madrid in the afternoon for Real Madrid's Bernabéu stadium.

days.bz: 在科尔多瓦。老城里走了一圈，从市政厅到一座座摆满花盆的庭院，喷泉、棕榈和攀在白墙上的三角梅。
days.be: Córdoba. A loop of the old town, from the city hall to patio after patio full of pots, fountains, palms and bougainvillea climbing the white walls.

days.bz: 在塞维利亚。吉拉尔达塔下是全世界最大的哥特式大教堂之一；上午去了美术馆，下午在王宫阿尔卡萨，摩尔式的厅堂和一大片花园。
days.be: Seville: the Giralda over one of the largest Gothic cathedrals anywhere. The Fine Arts Museum in the morning, and in the afternoon the Alcázar, its Moorish halls and long gardens.

days.bz: 在格拉纳达，从阿尔拜辛的山坡上看对面的阿尔罕布拉宫，后面是内华达山。然后下山去了天主教双王的皇家礼拜堂。
days.be: Granada: the Alhambra across the valley from the slopes of the Albaicín, the Sierra Nevada behind it. Then down to the Royal Chapel of the Catholic Monarchs.

days.bz: 晚上到巴塞罗那，沿着格拉西亚大道走，巴特罗之家和米拉之家亮着灯。
days.be: Into Barcelona in the evening and up the Passeig de Gràcia, Casa Batlló and Casa Milà lit up.

days.bz: 上午在居尔公园，糖果屋一样的门房和石头的高架廊道。下午看圣家堂，然后去老港边的加泰罗尼亚历史博物馆，傍晚在港口看帆船。
days.be: Park Güell in the morning, its gingerbread gatehouses and stone viaducts. The Sagrada Família in the afternoon, then the Museum of the History of Catalonia by the old port, and the yachts at dusk.

days.bz: 到波尔多。加龙河上是石头桥，城里立着吉伦特派纪念碑；又去看了罗马时代的加利安宫遗址和圣瑟兰教堂，下午在阿基坦博物馆。
days.be: Bordeaux: the stone bridge over the Garonne and the Girondins monument, then the Roman ruins of the Palais Gallien and the basilica of Saint-Seurin. The Musée d'Aquitaine in the afternoon.

days.bz: 到巴黎。上午在先贤祠，穹顶下挂着傅科摆。下午一直在卢浮宫，罗马马赛克、大卫的《萨宾妇女》，最后从玻璃金字塔下出来。
days.be: Paris. The Panthéon in the morning, Foucault's pendulum under the dome. The Louvre all afternoon: Roman mosaics, David's Intervention of the Sabine Women, and out under the glass pyramid.

days.bz: 从埃菲尔铁塔下走到罗丹美术馆，花园里能看到荣军院的金顶，馆里还挂着梵高的《唐吉老爹》。下午在奥赛博物馆，老火车站的大钟和拱顶。
days.be: From under the Eiffel Tower to the Musée Rodin, the gilded dome of Les Invalides over its garden and Van Gogh's Père Tanguy inside. The Musée d'Orsay in the afternoon, the old station's clock and vaults.

days.bz: 上午在孚日广场的雨果故居。然后去凯旋门，下午在蒙马特公墓，最后走到红磨坊。
days.be: Victor Hugo's house on the Place des Vosges in the morning. Then the Arc de Triomphe, the Montmartre cemetery in the afternoon, and on to the Moulin Rouge.

days.bz: 早上坐火车到斯特拉斯堡。玫瑰色砂岩的大教堂，河边的「小法兰西」都是半木结构的房子。
days.be: A morning train to Strasbourg: the rose-sandstone cathedral and the half-timbered houses of Petite France along the water.

days.bz: 在日内瓦。罗讷河从湖里流出来，湖边是纪念日内瓦加入瑞士的国家纪念碑。下午在老城，山坡上看得到湖和远处的山。
days.be: Geneva: the Rhône running out of the lake, and the National Monument marking the city joining Switzerland. The old town in the afternoon, the lake and the mountains from the hill.

days.bz: 在里昂的微缩与电影博物馆，看了许多电影布景和道具。然后上富维耶山看整座城。傍晚坐车翻过阿尔卑斯。
days.be: Lyon's Museum of Miniature and Cinema, full of film sets and props. Up Fourvière for the view over the city. Over the Alps by train in the evening.

days.bz: 在都灵，上午去埃及博物馆，看到了「伊西斯铜板」。然后是红砖的卡里尼亚诺宫和夫人宫，瓦伦蒂诺公园。傍晚到米兰，大教堂在夕阳里。
days.be: Turin: the Egyptian Museum in the morning and its Mensa Isiaca, then the brick Palazzo Carignano, Palazzo Madama and the Valentino park. Into Milan at dusk, the cathedral in the evening sun.

days.bz: 在米兰。大教堂旁边是埃马努埃莱二世长廊，穿过去是斯卡拉广场上的达·芬奇像。下午在布雷拉宫，院子中间立着拿破仑的铜像。
days.be: Milan: the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele beside the cathedral, through to Leonardo on the Piazza della Scala. The Palazzo di Brera in the afternoon, Napoleon in bronze in its courtyard.

days.bz: 在威尼斯。圣马可广场和钟楼，总督宫里一间间金色的天顶画。中午在小运河边走，下午坐火车沿着潟湖离开。
days.be: Venice: St Mark's Square and the campanile, and the Doge's Palace, room after room of gilded ceilings. A walk along the small canals at noon, and out by train across the lagoon in the afternoon.

days.bz: 在佛罗伦萨。上午在巴杰罗宫，然后到米开朗琪罗广场看整座城。下午在乌菲兹美术馆，最后到老宫和百花大教堂。
days.be: Florence: the Bargello in the morning, then the whole city from Piazzale Michelangelo. The Uffizi in the afternoon, then the Palazzo Vecchio and the Duomo.

days.bz: 在罗马，一早去看斗兽场，下到地下的通道。然后穿过提图斯凯旋门，上帕拉蒂尼山，俯看古罗马广场。
days.be: Rome, and the Colosseum first thing, down into its underground passages. Then through the Arch of Titus and up the Palatine, looking down on the Forum.

days.bz: 一早在圣彼得广场，爬上大教堂的穹顶看罗马。然后是梵蒂冈博物馆，马赛克地面、拉斐尔的房间。下午到圣天使堡。
days.be: St Peter's Square early, and up the dome for the view over Rome. Then the Vatican Museums, mosaic floors and the Raphael Rooms. Castel Sant'Angelo in the afternoon.

days.bz: 上午在万神殿。下午去博尔盖塞美术馆，卡拉瓦乔的画和满墙满顶的装饰。傍晚在戴克里先浴场的国立罗马博物馆。
days.be: The Pantheon in the morning. The Galleria Borghese in the afternoon, Caravaggio and walls and ceilings covered in decoration. The National Roman Museum at the Baths of Diocletian at dusk.

days.bz: 到那不勒斯，先吃一个油炸披萨。下午在国立考古博物馆，庞贝出土的马赛克、宝石和胸像。
days.be: Naples, and a fried pizza first. The National Archaeological Museum in the afternoon: mosaics, gems and busts from Pompeii and around.

days.bz: 最后一天在庞贝。从剧场走到广场，远处就是维苏威火山；石板路上还留着车辙，一直走到傍晚。
days.be: A last day at Pompeii, from the theatre to the forum with Vesuvius behind; ruts still in the paving stones, walking until evening.

lede.zh: 在柏林自由大学上了一个夏天的课。周末去波茨坦、布拉格、德累斯顿、汉堡、吕贝克和克拉科夫；课结束后，从魏玛、慕尼黑、新天鹅堡一路到莱茵河、特里尔和法兰克福。
lede.en: A summer of classes at the Free University of Berlin. Weekends in Potsdam, Prague, Dresden, Hamburg, Lübeck and Kraków; after the last class, Weimar, Munich, Neuschwanstein, the Rhine, Trier and Frankfurt.

2.zh: 布拉格、德累斯顿、汉堡、克拉科夫

days.bz: 转机飞到柏林泰格尔机场，下午沿着施普雷河走了一段。
days.be: A connecting flight into Berlin Tegel, and an afternoon walk along the Spree.

days.bz: 第一天在市中心：国会大厦，普鲁士议会大楼，以及旁边「恐怖地形图」保留下来的一段柏林墙。
days.be: A first day in the centre: the Reichstag, the old Prussian parliament, and the stretch of the Wall kept at the Topography of Terror next door.

days.bz: 暑期课程开学介绍。拿到了一份夏天的电影放映单，研究了一下柏林的地铁图，晚上自己做饭。
days.be: Orientation day for the summer courses: a programme of summer film nights, a long look at the U-Bahn map, and cooking at home in the evening.

days.bz: 下课后去勃兰登堡门，然后走到御林广场的法国大教堂。傍晚在旧书摊翻了翻，沿着运河走回去。
