days.be: The Brandenburg Gate after class, then the French Cathedral on the Gendarmenmarkt. Browsing a second-hand book stall at dusk, and back along the canal.

days.bz: 中午在一家中餐馆吃饭。下午的课在自由大学的东欧研究所，墙上爬满了常春藤。
days.be: Lunch at a Chinese restaurant. Afternoon class at the Free University's East European Institute, its sign half hidden in ivy.

days.bz: 去波茨坦。老市场上的圣尼古拉教堂，红砖的圣彼得保罗教堂。下午在无忧宫，腓特烈大王的墓上摆着土豆。
days.be: Potsdam: St Nicholas on the Old Market and the red-brick church of Saints Peter and Paul. Sanssouci in the afternoon, potatoes laid on Frederick the Great's grave.

days.bz: 下午上了国会大厦的玻璃穹顶，沿着螺旋坡道走到顶上，天阴着，整个柏林铺在脚下。
days.be: Up into the Reichstag's glass dome in the afternoon, round the spiral ramp to the top, Berlin spread out under a grey sky.

days.bz: 在博物馆岛。佩加蒙博物馆里的罗马马赛克、亚述浮雕和伊斯兰瓷砖，还有老国家美术馆柱廊下的雕塑。
days.be: Museum Island: Roman mosaics, Assyrian reliefs and Islamic tiles in the Pergamon, and sculpture under the colonnade of the Alte Nationalgalerie.

days.bz: 又去博物馆岛：佩加蒙的阿勒颇房间和彩绘木顶，新博物馆的埃及石刻，下午在博德博物馆的大理石圆厅和雕塑间。
days.be: Museum Island again: the Aleppo Room and a painted wooden ceiling in the Pergamon, Egyptian stonework in the Neues Museum, and the marble rotunda and sculpture halls of the Bode Museum in the afternoon.

days.bz: 周末到布拉格。瓦茨拉夫广场上有扬·帕拉赫的纪念地，老城的小巷，傍晚走到查理大桥和伏尔塔瓦河边。
days.be: A weekend in Prague: the Jan Palach memorial on Wenceslas Square, the lanes of the old town, and the Charles Bridge and the Vltava at dusk.

days.bz: 上午从城堡往下看红屋顶的小城区，看了一本泥金手抄本。中午在华伦斯坦宫的花园，下午到列侬墙。
days.be: The red roofs of the Lesser Town from the castle in the morning, and an illuminated manuscript. The Wallenstein Garden at noon, and the Lennon Wall in the afternoon.

days.bz: 到德累斯顿。王侯马队的瓷砖壁画长一百多米，旁边是天主教宫廷教堂。下午在茨温格宫的古代大师画廊看拉斐尔的《西斯廷圣母》。
days.be: Dresden: the Procession of Princes, a hundred-metre mural in porcelain tiles, next to the Catholic Court Church. Raphael's Sistine Madonna in the Old Masters gallery at the Zwinger in the afternoon.

days.bz: 周末到汉堡，内阿尔斯特湖边的拱廊和市政厅，市政厅是一座绿铜屋顶的新文艺复兴大楼。
days.be: A weekend in Hamburg: the arcades on the Inner Alster and the town hall, a neo-Renaissance pile under green copper roofs.

days.bz: 上午在汉堡看了一个德国殖民地的展，然后去林子里走了走。下午到吕贝克，布登勃洛克之家、红砖的市政厅，还有欧洲汉萨博物馆。
days.be: An exhibition on Germany's colonies in Hamburg in the morning, and a walk in the woods. Lübeck in the afternoon: the Buddenbrook House, the brick town hall, and the European Hansemuseum.

days.bz: 下午路过柏林大教堂，走进德国历史博物馆，从中世纪的纹章一直看到一战的海报。
days.be: Past the Berlin Cathedral and into the German Historical Museum, from medieval heraldry to posters of the First World War.

days.bz: 傍晚在城西的湖边，一直坐到太阳落山。
days.be: An evening by a lake on the west side of the city, until the sun went down.

days.en: A mosque and the Jewish Museum
days.bz: 上午在一片老墓园，旁边就是土耳其人的清真寺。傍晚在犹太博物馆，一万多张铁脸铺满空旷的展厅，名叫「落叶」。
days.be: An old cemetery in the morning, and the Turkish mosque beside it. The Jewish Museum at dusk, where more than ten thousand iron faces cover the floor of an empty hall, a work called Fallen Leaves.

days.bz: 坐夜车到波兰。上午在奥斯维辛集中营旧址。下午到克拉科夫，中央集市广场和圣母圣殿。
days.be: An overnight bus to Poland. The site of the Auschwitz camp in the morning. Kraków in the afternoon, the Main Market Square and St Mary's Basilica.

days.bz: 上午下到维利奇卡盐矿，雕像和吊灯都是盐做的。下午回到克拉科夫，上瓦维尔城堡，傍晚广场上有民族歌舞。
days.be: Down the Wieliczka salt mine in the morning, statues and chandeliers all carved from salt. Back in Kraków, up to Wawel Castle, and folk dancing on the square in the evening.

days.bz: 课结束了，往西南走。第一站魏玛，伊尔姆河公园里有歌德的花园小屋，城里是大象酒店和席勒博物馆。
days.be: Classes over, heading southwest. Weimar first: Goethe's garden house in the park on the Ilm, the Hotel Elephant and the Schiller Museum in town.

days.bz: 到慕尼黑。圣母教堂，国家剧院和王宫的一个个院子。下午在德意志博物馆。
days.be: Munich: the Frauenkirche, the National Theatre, and courtyard after courtyard of the Residenz. The Deutsches Museum in the afternoon.

days.bz: 去阿尔卑斯山脚的施万高。先看黄色的高天鹅堡，沿着阿尔卑湖走进林子，下午爬到山上，新天鹅堡立在峡谷边。
days.be: Schwangau at the foot of the Alps. The yellow Hohenschwangau first, then along the Alpsee and into the woods, and up the hill in the afternoon to Neuschwanstein on the edge of its gorge.

days.bz: 沿着莱茵河走。中午在科隆大教堂，下午到布吕尔的奥古斯都堡宫和花园，傍晚在波恩的明斯特广场，贝多芬像站在中间。
days.be: Along the Rhine: Cologne Cathedral at noon, Augustusburg Palace and its gardens at Brühl in the afternoon, and Beethoven in the middle of Bonn's Münsterplatz in the evening.

days.bz: 到特里尔，德国最老的城。罗马城门「黑门」，马克思的故居，下午走到摩泽尔河上的罗马桥，对岸是葡萄园。
days.be: Trier, Germany's oldest town: the Roman gate of the Porta Nigra, the house where Marx was born, and in the afternoon the Roman bridge over the Moselle, vineyards on the far bank.

days.bz: 最后一站法兰克福。罗马人广场的阶梯山墙，红砂岩的大教堂，钱币博物馆，欧洲央行门口的欧元标志。傍晚在美因河边。
days.be: Frankfurt to finish: the stepped gables of the Römerberg, the red sandstone cathedral, a coin museum, and the euro sign outside the old ECB tower. The Main at dusk.

lede.zh: 黄冈、团风、黄州东坡赤壁、武昌、汉口。
lede.en: Huanggang, Tuanfeng, Su Dongpo's Red Cliff at Huangzhou, Wuchang and Hankou.

days.en: Tuanfeng and the Red Cliff at Huangzhou
days.bz: 上午在黄冈团风的一处故居纪念馆，看了满墙的老照片和题字。下午到黄州的东坡赤壁，苏轼贬官黄州时在这里写下了前后《赤壁赋》，赤红的崖壁上刻着「赤壁」两个大字。
days.be: A former residence turned memorial hall in Tuanfeng, Huanggang, in the morning, its walls full of old photographs and inscriptions. In the afternoon, Dongpo Red Cliff at Huangzhou, where Su Shi wrote his two Red Cliff rhapsodies in exile, the characters for 'Red Cliff' carved into the red rock.

days.bz: 回到武汉。下午在湖北省博物馆，最有名的是曾侯乙编钟，一整架青铜钟挂在红色的展台上。旁边的湖北省艺术馆在办迎春展。晚上在江边看灯光。
days.be: Back in Wuhan. The Hubei Provincial Museum in the afternoon, famous for the bells of the Marquis Yi of Zeng, a whole rack of bronze bells on a red stand. The provincial art museum next door had a spring exhibition on. Lights along the river at night.

days.bz: 上午在一座红柱的寺院，然后到武昌起义纪念馆，就是当年湖北军政府所在的红楼，门口插着十八星旗，馆里画着 1911 年 10 月 10 日的起义。下午过江到汉口，看老街上的旧租界建筑。
days.be: A red-pillared temple in the morning, then the Wuchang Uprising Memorial, the Red House that held the Hubei military government, its eighteen-star flag at the gate and the uprising of 10 October 1911 drawn inside. Across the river to Hankou in the afternoon, for the old concession buildings.

days.bz: 上午在一处烈士陵园。下午去武汉大学，穿过「国立武汉大学」的老牌坊，上山看绿琉璃瓦的老校舍，墙上刻着「中华民国十九年国立武汉大学建」。傍晚到汉口的大智门老火车站。
days.be: A martyrs' memorial in the morning. Wuhan University in the afternoon: through the old 'National Wuhan University' gateway and up to the green-tiled buildings, one stone reading 'Built by National Wuhan University, 19th year of the Republic'. The old Dazhimen railway station in Hankou at dusk.

title.zh: 在高雄的一个学期，2014 年秋冬
title.en: A semester in Kaohsiung, autumn and winter 2014

lede.zh: 在高雄交换读书的半年。周末和假期往外跑：南边的猫鼻头和小琉球，台南的老城，阿里山和清境，北边的淡水、北投、九份、金瓜石和野柳。
lede.en: Half a year studying in Kaohsiung on exchange. Weekends and holidays away: Maobitou and Xiaoliuqiu in the south, old Tainan, Alishan and Cingjing in the mountains, and Tamsui, Beitou, Jiufen, Jinguashi and Yehliu in the north.

days.bz: 坐车一路往南到恒春半岛的猫鼻头公园，珊瑚礁岩一直铺到海里，海风很大。
days.be: South by bus to Maobitou Park on the Hengchun Peninsula, coral rock running out into the sea, the wind blowing hard.

days.bz: 到台南，下午在延平郡王祠，祭祀郑成功，红色的牌楼和福州式的祠堂。
days.be: Tainan, and an afternoon at the Yanping Prince shrine to Koxinga, its red gateway and Fuzhou-style hall.

days.bz: 在安平古堡，荷兰人建的热兰遮城，从瞭望台上看安平的老街和远处的海。
days.be: Anping Fort, the Dutch Fort Zeelandia, and the old streets of Anping and the sea from the lookout.

days.bz: 上阿里山，沿着森林铁路走进桧木林，神木的树根比人还高。傍晚坐小火车下山，茶园铺满了山坡。
days.be: Up to Alishan, along the forest railway into the cypress woods, the roots of the old trees taller than a person. Down on the little train at dusk, tea gardens covering the slopes.

days.bz: 坐船到小琉球，珊瑚礁的小岛，海水清得见底。岛上的老榕树根盘在石头上。
days.be: By boat to Xiaoliuqiu, a little coral island, the water clear to the bottom, old banyan roots gripping the rocks.

days.bz: 双十节放假，一早坐高铁北上，到淡水。山坡上的学校有宫灯教室，老街边是教堂和红砖楼，傍晚在河口的消波块上坐着，最后吃了一支土耳其冰淇淋。
days.be: The National Day holiday: north on the first high-speed train to Tamsui. Palace-style classrooms on the hill, a church and red-brick buildings by the old street, an evening on the breakwater at the river mouth, and a Turkish ice cream to finish.

days.bz: 上午在北投温泉区，溪水冒着热气。下午在台北看了一座宫殿式的纪念馆。
days.be: The Beitou hot-spring valley in the morning, its stream steaming. A palace-style memorial hall in Taipei in the afternoon.

days.bz: 往东北到基隆，下午在河边，晚上庙口夜市挂满了黄灯笼。
days.be: Northeast to Keelung, an afternoon by the river, and the Miaokou night market under its yellow lanterns.

days.bz: 在高雄西边的柴山，珊瑚礁石灰岩的山，山上都是猕猴，山下就是港口。
days.be: Shoushan on the west side of Kaohsiung, a hill of coral limestone full of macaques, the harbour at its foot.

days.bz: 到九份，傍晚在山城的老街上，茶馆里摆着一排茶碗。
days.be: Jiufen, the old streets of the hill town at dusk, a row of tea bowls in a teahouse.

days.bz: 在金瓜石的黄金博物馆，日据时代的矿山，山坡上是老宿舍和矿车轨道，神社只剩几根石柱，山上开满了芒草。
days.be: The Gold Museum at Jinguashi, a mine from the Japanese era: old dormitories and mine-cart tracks on the slope, a shrine reduced to a few stone pillars, silver grass all over the hills.

days.bz: 上合欢山，太鲁阁国家公园的高山，云雾里只看得清近处的冷杉。下午到清境农场，草坡上都是羊。
days.be: Up Hehuanshan in Taroko National Park, only the nearest firs clear through the cloud. Cingjing Farm in the afternoon, sheep all over the grassy slopes.

days.bz: 在高雄跨年，广场上搭着大舞台，摩天轮后面放起了烟火。
days.be: New Year's Eve in Kaohsiung, a huge stage in the square and fireworks behind the Ferris wheel.

days.bz: 在台北的西门町，街头有舞台，西门红楼里在办展览。晚上去看了一场戏，谢幕时台上站满了人。
days.be: Ximending in Taipei, a stage in the street and an exhibition in the Red House. A play in the evening, the whole cast out for the curtain call.

days.bz: 学期末去了北海岸的野柳，海蚀的砂岩上满是壶穴和蕈状岩，悬崖一直伸进海里。
days.be: Yehliu on the north coast at the end of term, the eroded sandstone full of potholes and mushroom rocks, the cape running out into the sea.

lede.zh: 从汉中出发，沿着古蜀道翻过秦岭和大巴山：石门栈道、明月峡、广元千佛崖，一路到成都和乐山。
lede.en: From Hanzhong along the old roads into Sichuan, over the Qinling and Daba mountains: the Shimen plank road, Mingyue Gorge, the Thousand Buddha Cliff at Guangyuan, and on to Chengdu and Leshan.

days.bz: 在汉中，上午看张骞出使西域的展览。下午到勉县，田里的稻子正绿，院子里是几百年的古柏。
days.be: Hanzhong, and an exhibition on Zhang Qian's mission to the Western Regions in the morning. Mianxian in the afternoon, rice green in the fields and centuries-old cypresses in the courtyards.

days.bz: 到褒河边的石门，褒斜道从这里进秦岭。河谷里复原了一段栈道，崖壁上刻着历代的题字。
days.be: Shimen on the Bao River, where the Baoxie road entered the Qinling. A stretch of plank road rebuilt along the gorge, and inscriptions from every age carved in the cliffs.

days.en: Mingyue Gorge and the Thousand Buddha Cliff
days.bz: 进四川，上午在嘉陵江的明月峡，江边的崖壁上还留着古栈道的孔洞。下午到广元的千佛崖，一整面崖壁的佛龛。
days.be: Into Sichuan: Mingyue Gorge on the Jialing in the morning, the sockets of the old plank road still in the cliff. The Thousand Buddha Cliff at Guangyuan in the afternoon, a whole rock face of niches.

days.bz: 在山里沿着古道走，石板路、溪谷和石刻，中午走到一座牌坊下。
days.be: Along the old road in the hills, stone paving, a stream valley and carvings, reaching a stone gateway at noon.

days.bz: 到成都，在老街的小巷里走。
days.be: Chengdu, and the narrow lanes of an old quarter.

days.bz: 下午在一座老园子里，竹林和垂柳，馆里有旧文书和一座木塔的模型。
days.be: An old garden in the afternoon, bamboo and weeping willows, old documents and a model of a wooden tower inside.

days.bz: 最后一天到乐山，大佛坐在三江汇流的崖壁上，从头顶一直走到脚下。
days.be: A last day at Leshan, the Giant Buddha seated in the cliff where three rivers meet, from the top of his head down to his feet.

lede.zh: 第一次去日本。先在东京，然后到京都住了一个星期，正赶上祇园祭，中间去了一趟大阪城。
lede.en: A first trip to Japan: Tokyo, then a week in Kyoto during the Gion Festival, with a day at Osaka Castle.

days.bz: 傍晚坐大巴进东京，车窗外闪过东京塔红白的钢架。
days.be: Into Tokyo by bus in the evening, the red and white steel of Tokyo Tower flashing past the window.

days.bz: 在东京大学本乡校区的三四郎池，夏目漱石的小说《三四郎》让这个池子得了名字。
days.be: Sanshiro Pond on the University of Tokyo's Hongo campus, named after Natsume Sōseki's novel.

days.bz: 在东京走了一天，老树、松林、神社和石碑，傍晚到了一片新的高楼中间。
days.be: A day walking in Tokyo: old trees, pines, a shrine and its stones, and new towers by evening.

days.bz: 在京都。中午路过二条城的护城河，傍晚到八坂神社，正是祇园祭，门口挂满了灯笼；然后在祇园的小街里走到天黑。
days.be: Kyoto. Past the moat of Nijō Castle at midday, and Yasaka Shrine at dusk, hung with lanterns for the Gion Festival; then the lanes of Gion until dark.

days.bz: 去大阪城，石墙和护城河，从天守阁上往下看整片城郭。
days.be: Osaka Castle: stone walls and moats, and the whole castle grounds from the top of the keep.

days.bz: 在京都御苑的松林里走，下午到一座寺院，院墙外是一片枫树。
days.be: A walk through the pines of the Kyoto Imperial Gardens, and a temple in the afternoon, maples beyond its walls.

days.bz: 晚上沿着高濑川走到鸭川边，对岸的灯映在水里。
days.be: Along the Takase canal to the Kamo River at night, the lights of the far bank in the water.
